   8 | // --- FRONTEND SABOTAGE TRACKER (Audit Trail Logger) ---
   9 | // Catches crashes when React code is maliciously deleted, pushes them directly to Database Audit Log!
  10 | window.addEventListener('error', (event) => {
  11 |     const errorFile = event.filename ? `File: ${event.filename}:${event.lineno}` : `Page: ${window.location.href}`;
  12 |     const stackTrace = event.error?.stack ? ` | Trace: ${event.error.stack.split('\n')[1]?.trim()}` : '';
  13 |     
  14 |     fetch('/api/system-error', {
  15 |         method: 'POST',
  16 |         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  17 |         body: JSON.stringify({ message: event.message + stackTrace, url: errorFile })
  18 |     }).catch(() => {});
  19 | });
  20 | window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (event) => {
  21 |     fetch('/api/system-error', {
  22 |         method: 'POST',
  23 |         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  24 |         body: JSON.stringify({ message: event.reason?.message || 'Unhandled Promise Crash', url: window.location.href })
  25 |     }).catch(() => {});
  26 | });
  27 | // ------------------------------------------------------
  28 | 
  29 | const appName = import.meta.env.VITE_APP_NAME || 'Laravel';
  30 | 
  31 | createInertiaApp({
  32 |     title: (title) => (title ? `${title} - ${appName}` : appName),
  33 |     resolve: (name) =>
  34 |         resolvePageComponent(
  35 |             `./pages/${name}.tsx`,
  36 |             import.meta.glob('./pages/**/*.tsx'),
  37 |         ),
  38 |     setup({ el, App, props }) {
  39 |         const root = createRoot(el);
  40 | 
  41 |         root.render(
  42 |             <StrictMode>
  43 |                 <App {...props} />
  44 |             </StrictMode>,
  45 |         );
  46 |     },
  47 |     progress: {
  48 |         color: '#4B5563',
  49 |     },

  16 | export function NavMain({ items = [] }: { items: NavItem[] }) {
  17 |     const { isCurrentUrl } = useCurrentUrl();
  18 |     const { url } = usePage();
  19 | 
  20 |     // State for expanded menu groups
  21 |     const [openGroups, setOpenGroups] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({
  22 |         Documents: true, // Open by default
  23 |     });
  24 | 
  25 |     const toggleGroup = (title: string) => {
  26 |         setOpenGroups((prev) => ({
  27 |             ...prev,
  28 |             [title]: !prev[title],
  29 |         }));
  30 |     };
  31 | 
  32 |     return (
  33 |         <SidebarGroup className="px-2 py-0">
  34 |             <SidebarMenu>
  35 |                 {items.map((item) => {
  36 |                     const hasSubItems = item.items && item.items.length > 0;
  37 |                     const isParentActive = hasSubItems && item.items?.some((sub) => {
  38 |                         const hrefStr = typeof sub.href === 'string' ? sub.href : String(sub.href);
  39 |                         return url.startsWith(hrefStr);
  40 |                     });
  41 |                     const isOpen = openGroups[item.title] ?? isParentActive;
  42 | 
  43 |                     if (hasSubItems) {
  44 |                         return (
  45 |                             <SidebarMenuItem key={item.title} className="space-y-1">
  46 |                                 <SidebarMenuButton
  47 |                                     onClick={() => toggleGroup(item.title)}
  48 |                                     isActive={isParentActive}
  49 |                                     tooltip={{ children: item.title }}
  50 |                                     className="cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between"
  51 |                                 >
  52 |                                     <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
  53 |                                         {item.icon && (
  54 |                                             <div className="flex bg-[#dd8b11] rounded-md p-1 items-center justify-center shrink-0">
  55 |                                                 <item.icon className="h-4 w-4 text-white dark:text-black" />
  56 |                                             </div>
  57 |                                         )}
  58 |                                         <span className="font-semibold">{item.title}</span>
  59 |                                     </div>
  60 |                                     {isOpen ? (
  61 |                                         <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground transition-transform" />
  62 |                                     ) : (
  63 |                                         <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground transition-transform" />
  64 |                                     )}
  65 |                                 </SidebarMenuButton>
  66 | 
  67 |                                 {isOpen && (
  68 |                                     <div className="ml-4 pl-2 border-l border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800/60 space-y-1 my-1">
  69 |                                         {item.items?.map((sub) => {
  70 |                                             const subHref = typeof sub.href === 'string' ? sub.href : String(sub.href);
  71 |                                             const isSubActive = url === subHref || url.startsWith(subHref);
  72 |                                             const SubIcon = sub.icon || FileText;
  73 |                                             return (
  74 |                                                 <Link
  75 |                                                     key={sub.title}
  76 |                                                     href={sub.href}
  77 |                                                     className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs transition-colors font-medium ${
  78 |                                                         isSubActive
  79 |                                                             ? 'bg-amber-500/15 text-[#dd8b11] dark:text-amber-400 font-bold shadow-xs'
  80 |                                                             : 'text-sidebar-foreground/80 hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground'
  81 |                                                     }`}
  82 |                                                 >
  83 |                                                     <SubIcon className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${isSubActive ? 'text-[#dd8b11]' : 'text-muted-foreground'}`} />
  84 |                                                     <span>{sub.title}</span>
  85 |                                                 </Link>
  86 |                                             );
  87 |                                         })}
  88 |                                     </div>
  89 |                                 )}
  90 |                             </SidebarMenuItem>
  91 |                         );
  92 |                     }
  93 | 
  94 |                     return (
  95 |                         <SidebarMenuItem key={item.title}>
  96 |                             <SidebarMenuButton
  97 |                                 asChild
  98 |                                 isActive={isCurrentUrl(item.href)}
  99 |                                 tooltip={{ children: item.title }}
 100 |                             >
 101 |                                 <Link href={item.href}>
 102 |                                     {item.icon && (
 103 |                                         <div className="flex bg-[#dd8b11] rounded-md p-1 items-center justify-center shrink-0">
 104 |                                             <item.icon className="h-4 w-4 text-white dark:text-black" />
 105 |                                         </div>
 106 |                                     )}
 107 |                                     <span>{item.title}</span>
 108 |                                 </Link>
 109 |                             </SidebarMenuButton>
 110 |                         </SidebarMenuItem>
 111 |                     );
 112 |                 })}
 113 |             </SidebarMenu>

  35 | export interface NotificationItem {
  36 |     id: number;
  37 |     user_id: number;
  38 |     audit_log_id: number | null;
  39 |     title: string;
  40 |     details: string | null;

  48 | function formatRelativeTime(dateString: string): string {
  49 |     if (!dateString) return '';
  50 |     const date = new Date(dateString);
  51 |     const now = new Date();
  52 |     const seconds = Math.floor((now.getTime() - date.getTime()) / 1000);
  53 | 
  54 |     if (isNaN(seconds) || seconds < 5) return 'Just now';
  55 |     if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds}s ago`;
  56 |     const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  57 |     if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m ago`;
  58 |     const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  59 |     if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h ago`;
  60 |     const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  61 |     if (days < 30) return `${days}d ago`;
  62 |     return date.toLocaleDateString();
  63 | }
  64 | 
  65 | function isAuthOrSecurityEvent(item: NotificationItem): boolean {
  66 |     const link = item.link || '';
  67 |     const action = (item.action || '').toUpperCase();
  68 |     const module = (item.module || '').toLowerCase();
  69 | 
  70 |     return link === '/audit' ||
  71 |            link === '/dashboard' ||
  72 |            action.includes('LOGIN') ||
  73 |            action.includes('LOGOUT') ||
  74 |            action.includes('AUTH') ||
  75 |            action.includes('USER') ||
  76 |            module.includes('auth') ||
  77 |            module.includes('login') ||
  78 |            module.includes('security') ||
  79 |            module.includes('user') ||
  80 |            module.includes('kernel') ||
  81 |            module.includes('system');
  82 | }
  83 | 
  84 | function getActionBadge(action: string | null, module: string | null) {
  85 |     const act = (action || '').toUpperCase();
  86 |     const mod = (module || '').toLowerCase();
  87 | 
  88 |     if (act.includes('CREATE') || act.includes('ADD') || act.includes('UPLOAD')) {
  89 |         return {
  90 |             bg: 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/20',
  91 |             icon: FolderPlus,
  92 |         };
  93 |     }
  94 |     if (act.includes('UPDATE') || act.includes('EDIT') || act.includes('SAVE')) {
  95 |         return {
  96 |             bg: 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border-blue-500/20',
  97 |             icon: RefreshCw,
  98 |         };
  99 |     }
 100 |     if (act.includes('DELETE') || act.includes('REMOVE') || act.includes('CANCEL')) {
 101 |         return {
 102 |             bg: 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border-rose-500/20',
 103 |             icon: Trash2,
 104 |         };
 105 |     }
 106 |     if (mod.includes('auth') || mod.includes('login') || mod.includes('security') || act.includes('LOGIN') || act.includes('LOGOUT')) {
 107 |         return {
 108 |             bg: 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border-amber-500/20',
 109 |             icon: Shield,
 110 |         };
 111 |     }
 112 |     if (mod.includes('user')) {
 113 |         return {
 114 |             bg: 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border-amber-500/20',
 115 |             icon: UserCheck,
 116 |         };
 117 |     }
 118 | 
 119 |     return {
 120 |         bg: 'bg-primary/10 text-primary border-primary/20',
 121 |         icon: Activity,
 122 |     };
 123 | }

 125 | export function NotificationBell() {
 126 |     const { auth } = usePage<SharedData>().props;
 127 |     const userRole = auth?.user?.role || (auth?.roles && auth.roles[0]) || '';
 128 |     const isAdmin = Boolean(userRole === 'Administrator' || userRole === 'Admin' || auth?.roles?.includes('Administrator') || auth?.roles?.includes('Admin'));
 129 | 
 130 |     const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<NotificationItem[]>([]);
 131 |     const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState<number>(0);
 132 |     const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
 133 |     const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
 134 |     const [selectedEventNotification, setSelectedEventNotification] = useState<NotificationItem | null>(null);
 135 | 
 136 |     const fetchNotifications = useCallback(async () => {
 137 |         try {
 138 |             const response = await fetch('/notifications', {
 139 |                 headers: {
 140 |                     'Accept': 'application/json',
 141 |                     'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
 142 |                 },
 143 |             });
 144 |             if (response.ok) {
 145 |                 const data = await response.json();
 146 |                 setNotifications(data.notifications || []);
 147 |                 setUnreadCount(data.unread_count || 0);
 148 |             }
 149 |         } catch (error) {
 150 |             console.error('Failed to fetch notifications:', error);
 151 |         }
 152 |     }, []);
 153 | 
 154 |     useEffect(() => {
 155 |         fetchNotifications();
 156 |         // Poll every 12 seconds
 157 |         const interval = setInterval(fetchNotifications, 12000);
 158 |         return () => clearInterval(interval);
 159 |     }, [fetchNotifications]);
 160 | 
 161 |     const getCsrfToken = () => {
 162 |         return document.querySelector<HTMLMetaElement>('meta[name="csrf-token"]')?.content || '';
 163 |     };
 164 | 
 165 |     const handleMarkAsRead = async (e: React.MouseEvent, id: number) => {
 166 |         if (e) e.stopPropagation();
 167 |         try {
 168 |             const response = await fetch(`/notifications/${id}/read`, {
 169 |                 method: 'POST',
 170 |                 headers: {
 171 |                     'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 172 |                     'X-CSRF-TOKEN': getCsrfToken(),
 173 |                     'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
 174 |                 },
 175 |             });
 176 |             if (response.ok) {
 177 |                 setNotifications(prev =>
 178 |                     prev.map(item => item.id === id ? { ...item, read_at: new Date().toISOString() } : item)
 179 |                 );
 180 |                 setUnreadCount(prev => Math.max(0, prev - 1));
 181 |             }
 182 |         } catch (error) {
 183 |             console.error('Failed to mark notification as read:', error);
 184 |         }
 185 |     };
 186 | 
 187 |     const handleMarkAllAsRead = async () => {
 188 |         try {
 189 |             setLoading(true);
 190 |             const response = await fetch('/notifications/read-all', {
 191 |                 method: 'POST',
 192 |                 headers: {
 193 |                     'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 194 |                     'X-CSRF-TOKEN': getCsrfToken(),
 195 |                     'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
 196 |                 },
 197 |             });
 198 |             if (response.ok) {
 199 |                 const now = new Date().toISOString();
 200 |                 setNotifications(prev => prev.map(item => ({ ...item, read_at: item.read_at || now })));
 201 |                 setUnreadCount(0);
 202 |             }
 203 |         } catch (error) {
 204 |             console.error('Failed to mark all as read:', error);
 205 |         } finally {
 206 |             setLoading(false);
 207 |         }
 208 |     };
 209 | 
 210 |     const handleNotificationClick = (item: NotificationItem) => {
 211 |         if (!item.read_at) {
 212 |             fetch(`/notifications/${item.id}/read`, {
 213 |                 method: 'POST',
 214 |                 headers: {
 215 |                     'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 216 |                     'X-CSRF-TOKEN': getCsrfToken(),
 217 |                     'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
 218 |                 },
 219 |             }).catch(console.error);
 220 | 
 221 |             setNotifications(prev =>
 222 |                 prev.map(n => n.id === item.id ? { ...n, read_at: new Date().toISOString() } : n)
 223 |             );
 224 |             setUnreadCount(prev => Math.max(0, prev - 1));
 225 |         }
 226 | 
 227 |         setIsOpen(false);
 228 | 
 229 |         // If it is a Sign In / Logout / Auth event, pop up the details modal directly on Dashboard

 233 |         }
 234 |

 237 |         } else {
 238 |             setSelectedEventNotification(item);
 239 |         }
 240 |     };
 241 |

 247 |             }}>
 248 |                 <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
 249 |                     <Button
 250 |                         variant="ghost"
 251 |                         size="icon"
 252 |                         className="relative h-9 w-9 rounded-full hover:bg-neutral-100 dark:hover:bg-neutral-800 transition-colors"
 253 |                         aria-label="Notifications"
 254 |                     >
 255 |                         <Bell className="h-4 w-4 text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-300" />
 256 |                         {unreadCount > 0 && (
 257 |                             <span className="absolute -top-0.5 -right-0.5 flex h-4 min-w-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-rose-600 px-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-white shadow-sm animate-in zoom-in duration-200">
 258 |                                 {unreadCount > 99 ? '99+' : unreadCount}

 290 | 
 291 |                     {/* Notifications List */}

 293 |                         {notifications.length === 0 ? (

 141 | function TwoFactorVerificationStep({
 142 |     onClose,
 143 |     onBack,
 144 | }: {
 145 |     onClose: () => void;
 146 |     onBack: () => void;
 147 | }) {
 148 |     const [code, setCode] = useState<string>('');
 149 |     const pinInputContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
 150 |

 154 |         }, 0);
 155 |     }, []);
 156 | 
 157 |     return (
 158 |         <Form
 159 |             {...confirm.form()}
 160 |             onSuccess={() => onClose()}

 162 |             resetOnSuccess
 163 |         >
 164 |             {({
 165 |                 processing,
 166 |                 errors,
 167 |             }: {
 168 |                 processing: boolean;
 169 |                 errors?: { confirmTwoFactorAuthentication?: { code?: string } };

 173 |                         ref={pinInputContainerRef}

 179 |                                 name="code"
 180 |                                 maxLength={OTP_MAX_LENGTH}
 181 |                                 onChange={setCode}
 182 |                                 disabled={processing}

 184 |                             >
 185 |                                 <InputOTPGroup>
 186 |                                     {Array.from(
 187 |                                         { length: OTP_MAX_LENGTH },

 205 |                             <Button
 206 |                                 type="button"

 213 |                             </Button>

 225 |                 </>

 231 | type Props = {
 232 |     isOpen: boolean;
 233 |     onClose: () => void;
 234 |     requiresConfirmation: boolean;
 235 |     twoFactorEnabled: boolean;
 236 |     qrCodeSvg: string | null;

 238 |     clearSetupData: () => void;

 243 | export default function TwoFactorSetupModal({
 244 |     isOpen,
 245 |     onClose,
 246 |     requiresConfirmation,
 247 |     twoFactorEnabled,
 248 |     qrCodeSvg,
 249 |     manualSetupKey,
 250 |     clearSetupData,
 251 |     fetchSetupData,
 252 |     errors,
 253 | }: Props) {
 254 |     const [showVerificationStep, setShowVerificationStep] =
 255 |         useState<boolean>(false);
 256 | 
 257 |     const modalConfig = useMemo<{
 258 |         title: string;
 259 |         description: string;
 260 |         buttonText: string;
 261 |     }>(() => {
 262 |         if (twoFactorEnabled) {
 263 |             return {
 264 |                 title: 'Two-Factor Authentication Enabled',
 265 |                 description:
 266 |                     'Two-factor authentication is now enabled. Scan the QR code or enter the setup key in your authenticator app.',
 267 |                 buttonText: 'Close',
 268 |             };
 269 |         }
 270 | 
 271 |         if (showVerificationStep) {
 272 |             return {
 273 |                 title: 'Verify Authentication Code',
 274 |                 description:
 275 |                     'Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app',
 276 |                 buttonText: 'Continue',
 277 |             };
 278 |         }
 279 | 
 280 |         return {
 281 |             title: 'Enable Two-Factor Authentication',
 282 |             description:
 283 |                 'To finish enabling two-factor authentication, scan the QR code or enter the setup key in your authenticator app',
 284 |             buttonText: 'Continue',
 285 |         };
 286 |     }, [twoFactorEnabled, showVerificationStep]);
 287 | 
 288 |     const handleModalNextStep = useCallback(() => {
 289 |         if (requiresConfirmation) {
 290 |             setShowVerificationStep(true);
 291 |             return;
 292 |         }
 293 | 
 294 |         clearSetupData();
 295 |         onClose();
 296 |     }, [requiresConfirmation, clearSetupData, onClose]);
 297 | 
 298 |     const resetModalState = useCallback(() => {
 299 |         setShowVerificationStep(false);
 300 | 
 301 |         if (twoFactorEnabled) {
 302 |             clearSetupData();
 303 |         }
 304 |     }, [twoFactorEnabled, clearSetupData]);
 305 | 
 306 |     useEffect(() => {
 307 |         if (isOpen && !qrCodeSvg) {
 308 |             fetchSetupData();
 309 |         }
 310 |     }, [isOpen, qrCodeSvg, fetchSetupData]);
 311 | 
 312 |     const handleClose = useCallback(() => {
 313 |         resetModalState();
 314 |         onClose();
 315 |     }, [onClose, resetModalState]);
 316 | 
 317 |     return (
 318 |         <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={(open) => !open && handleClose()}>
 319 |             <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
 320 |                 <DialogHeader className="flex items-center justify-center">
 321 |                     <GridScanIcon />
 322 |                     <DialogTitle>{modalConfig.title}</DialogTitle>
 323 |                     <DialogDescription className="text-center">
 324 |                         {modalConfig.description}
 325 |                     </DialogDescription>
 326 |                 </DialogHeader>
 327 |

 331 |                             onClose={onClose}
 332 |                             onBack={() => setShowVerificationStep(false)}
 333 |                         />
 334 |                     ) : (
 335 |                         <TwoFactorSetupStep
 336 |                             qrCodeSvg={qrCodeSvg}
 337 |                             manualSetupKey={manualSetupKey}
 338 |                             buttonText={modalConfig.buttonText}
 339 |                             onNextStep={handleModalNextStep}
 340 |                             errors={errors}
 341 |                         />
 342 |                     )}
 343 |                 </div>
 344 |             </DialogContent>
 345 |         </Dialog>
 346 |     );
 347 | }

   1 | import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot"

  19 |   Tooltip,

  21 |   TooltipProvider,

  26 | 
  27 | const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME = "sidebar_state"
  28 | const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE = 60 * 60 * 24 * 7
  29 | const SIDEBAR_WIDTH = "16rem"
  30 | const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE = "18rem"
  31 | const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON = "3rem"
  32 | const SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT = "b"
  33 | 
  34 | type SidebarContext = {
  35 |   state: "expanded" | "collapsed"
  36 |   open: boolean
  37 |   setOpen: (open: boolean) => void
  38 |   openMobile: boolean
  39 |   setOpenMobile: (open: boolean) => void
  40 |   isMobile: boolean
  41 |   toggleSidebar: () => void
  42 | }
  43 | 
  44 | const SidebarContext = React.createContext<SidebarContext | null>(null)
  45 | 
  46 | function useSidebar() {
  47 |   const context = React.useContext(SidebarContext)
  48 |   if (!context) {
  49 |     throw new Error("useSidebar must be used within a SidebarProvider.")
  50 |   }
  51 | 
  52 |   return context
  53 | }
  54 | 
  55 | function SidebarProvider({
  56 |   defaultOpen = true,
  57 |   open: openProp,
  58 |   onOpenChange: setOpenProp,
  59 |   className,
  60 |   style,
  61 |   children,
  62 |   ...props
  63 | }: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  64 |   defaultOpen?: boolean
  65 |   open?: boolean
  66 |   onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void
  67 | }) {
  68 |   const isMobile = useIsMobile()
  69 |   const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = React.useState(false)
  70 | 
  71 |   // This is the internal state of the sidebar.
  72 |   // We use openProp and setOpenProp for control from outside the component.
  73 |   const [_open, _setOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen)
  74 |   const open = openProp ?? _open
  75 |   const setOpen = React.useCallback(
  76 |     (value: boolean | ((value: boolean) => boolean)) => {
  77 |       const openState = typeof value === "function" ? value(open) : value
  78 |       if (setOpenProp) {
  79 |         setOpenProp(openState)
  80 |       } else {
  81 |         _setOpen(openState)
  82 |       }
  83 | 
  84 |       // Store sidebar state in localStorage instead of HTTP cookie
  85 |       if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
  86 |         localStorage.setItem(SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME, String(openState))
  87 |       }
  88 |     },
  89 |     [setOpenProp, open]
  90 |   )
  91 | 
  92 |   // Helper to toggle the sidebar.
  93 |   const toggleSidebar = React.useCallback(() => {
  94 |     return isMobile ? setOpenMobile((open) => !open) : setOpen((open) => !open)
  95 |   }, [isMobile, setOpen, setOpenMobile])
  96 | 
  97 |   // Adds a keyboard shortcut to toggle the sidebar.
  98 |   React.useEffect(() => {
  99 |     const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
 100 |       if (
 101 |         event.key === SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT &&
 102 |         (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)
 103 |       ) {
 104 |         event.preventDefault()
 105 |         toggleSidebar()
 106 |       }
 107 |     }
 108 | 
 109 |     window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
 110 |     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
 111 |   }, [toggleSidebar])
 112 | 
 113 |   // We add a state so that we can do data-state="expanded" or "collapsed".
 114 |   // This makes it easier to style the sidebar with Tailwind classes.
 115 |   const state = open ? "expanded" : "collapsed"
 116 | 
 117 |   const contextValue = React.useMemo<SidebarContext>(
 118 |     () => ({
 119 |       state,
 120 |       open,
 121 |       setOpen,
 122 |       isMobile,
 123 |       openMobile,
 124 |       setOpenMobile,
 125 |       toggleSidebar,
 126 |     }),
 127 |     [state, open, setOpen, isMobile, openMobile, setOpenMobile, toggleSidebar]
 128 |   )
 129 | 
 130 |   return (
 131 |     <SidebarContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
 132 |       <TooltipProvider delayDuration={0}>
 133 |         <div
 134 |           data-slot="sidebar-wrapper"
 135 |           style={
 136 |             {
 137 |               "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH,
 138 |               "--sidebar-width-icon": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON,
 139 |               ...style,
 140 |             } as React.CSSProperties
 141 |           }
 142 |           className={cn(
 143 |             "group/sidebar-wrapper has-data-[variant=inset]:bg-sidebar flex min-h-svh w-full",
 144 |             className
 145 |           )}
 146 |           {...props}
 147 |         >
 148 |           {children}
 149 |         </div>
 150 |       </TooltipProvider>
 151 |     </SidebarContext.Provider>
 152 |   )
 153 | }
 154 | 
 155 | function Sidebar({
 156 |   side = "left",
 157 |   variant = "sidebar",
 158 |   collapsible = "offcanvas",
 159 |   className,
 160 |   children,
 161 |   ...props
 162 | }: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
 163 |   side?: "left" | "right"
 164 |   variant?: "sidebar" | "floating" | "inset"
 165 |   collapsible?: "offcanvas" | "icon" | "none"
 166 | }) {
 167 |   const { isMobile, state, openMobile, setOpenMobile } = useSidebar()
 168 | 
 169 |   if (collapsible === "none") {
 170 |     return (
 171 |       <div
 172 |         data-slot="sidebar"
 173 |         className={cn(
 174 |           "bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground flex h-full w-(--sidebar-width) flex-col",
 175 |           className
 176 |         )}
 177 |         {...props}
 178 |       >
 179 |         {children}
 180 |       </div>
 181 |     )
 182 |   }
 183 | 
 184 |   if (isMobile) {
 185 |     return (
 186 |       <Sheet open={openMobile} onOpenChange={setOpenMobile} {...props}>
 187 |         <SheetHeader className="sr-only">
 188 |           <SheetTitle>Sidebar</SheetTitle>
 189 |           <SheetDescription>Displays the mobile sidebar.</SheetDescription>
 190 |         </SheetHeader>
 191 |         <SheetContent
 192 |           data-sidebar="sidebar"
 193 |           data-slot="sidebar"
 194 |           data-mobile="true"
 195 |           className="bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground w-(--sidebar-width) p-0 [&>button]:hidden"
 196 |           style={
 197 |             {
 198 |               "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE,
 199 |             } as React.CSSProperties
 200 |           }
 201 |           side={side}
 202 |         >
 203 |           <div className="flex h-full w-full flex-col">{children}</div>
 204 |         </SheetContent>
 205 |       </Sheet>
 206 |     )
 207 |   }
 208 | 
 209 |   return (
 210 |     <div
 211 |       className="group peer text-sidebar-foreground hidden md:block"
 212 |       data-state={state}
 213 |       data-collapsible={state === "collapsed" ? collapsible : ""}
 214 |       data-variant={variant}
 215 |       data-side={side}
 216 |       data-slot="sidebar"
 217 |     >
 218 |       {/* This is what handles the sidebar gap on desktop */}
 219 |       <div
 220 |         className={cn(
 221 |           "relative h-svh w-(--sidebar-width) bg-transparent transition-[width] duration-200 ease-linear",
 222 |           "group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:w-0",
 223 |           "group-data-[side=right]:rotate-180",
 224 |           variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"
 225 |             ? "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)+(--spacing(4)))]"
 226 |             : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-(--sidebar-width-icon)"
 227 |         )}
 228 |       />

 496 | function SidebarMenuButton({
 497 |   asChild = false,
 498 |   isActive = false,
 499 |   variant = "default",
 500 |   size = "default",
 501 |   tooltip,
 502 |   className,
 503 |   ...props
 504 | }: React.ComponentProps<"button"> & {
 505 |   asChild?: boolean
 506 |   isActive?: boolean
 507 |   tooltip?: string | React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipContent>
 508 | } & VariantProps<typeof sidebarMenuButtonVariants>) {
 509 |   const Comp = asChild ? Slot : "button"
 510 |   const { isMobile, state } = useSidebar()
 511 | 
 512 |   const button = (
 513 |     <Comp
 514 |       data-slot="sidebar-menu-button"
 515 |       data-sidebar="menu-button"
 516 |       data-size={size}
 517 |       data-active={isActive}
 518 |       className={cn(sidebarMenuButtonVariants({ variant, size }), className)}
 519 |       {...props}
 520 |     />
 521 |   )
 522 | 
 523 |   if (!tooltip) {
 524 |     return button
 525 |   }
 526 | 
 527 |   if (typeof tooltip === "string") {
 528 |     tooltip = {
 529 |       children: tooltip,
 530 |     }
 531 |   }
 532 | 
 533 |   return (
 534 |     <Tooltip>
 535 |       <TooltipTrigger asChild>{button}</TooltipTrigger>
 536 |       <TooltipContent
 537 |         side="right"
 538 |         align="center"
 539 |         hidden={state !== "collapsed" || isMobile}
 540 |         {...tooltip}
 541 |       />
 542 |     </Tooltip>
 543 |   )
 544 | }

FILE #181: resources/js/hooks/use-appearance.tsx
Lines: 97 | Size: 2.7 KB

   1 | import { useCallback, useMemo, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
   2 | 
   3 | export type ResolvedAppearance = 'light' | 'dark';
   4 | export type Appearance = ResolvedAppearance | 'system';
   5 | 
   6 | export type UseAppearanceReturn = {
   7 |     readonly appearance: Appearance;
   8 |     readonly resolvedAppearance: ResolvedAppearance;
   9 |     readonly updateAppearance: (mode: Appearance) => void;
  10 | };
  11 | 
  12 | const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  13 | let currentAppearance: Appearance = 'system';
  14 | 
  15 | const prefersDark = (): boolean => {
  16 |     if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  17 | 
  18 |     return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
  19 | };
  20 | 
  21 | const getStoredAppearance = (): Appearance => {
  22 |     if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'system';
  23 | 
  24 |     return (localStorage.getItem('appearance') as Appearance) || 'system';
  25 | };
  26 | 
  27 | const isDarkMode = (appearance: Appearance): boolean => {
  28 |     return appearance === 'dark' || (appearance === 'system' && prefersDark());
  29 | };
  30 | 
  31 | const applyTheme = (appearance: Appearance): void => {
  32 |     if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
  33 | 
  34 |     const isDark = isDarkMode(appearance);
  35 | 
  36 |     document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', isDark);
  37 |     document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = isDark ? 'dark' : 'light';
  38 | };
  39 | 
  40 | const subscribe = (callback: () => void) => {
  41 |     listeners.add(callback);
  42 | 
  43 |     return () => listeners.delete(callback);
  44 | };
  45 | 
  46 | const notify = (): void => listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
  47 | 
  48 | const mediaQuery = (): MediaQueryList | null => {
  49 |     if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  50 | 
  51 |     return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
  52 | };
  53 | 
  54 | const handleSystemThemeChange = (): void => {
  55 |     applyTheme(currentAppearance);
  56 |     notify();
  57 | };
  58 | 
  59 | export function initializeTheme(): void {
  60 |     if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  61 | 
  62 |     if (!localStorage.getItem('appearance')) {
  63 |         localStorage.setItem('appearance', 'system');
  64 |     }
  65 | 
  66 |     currentAppearance = getStoredAppearance();
  67 |     applyTheme(currentAppearance);
  68 | 
  69 |     // Set up system theme change listener
  70 |     mediaQuery()?.addEventListener('change', handleSystemThemeChange);
  71 | }
  72 | 
  73 | export function useAppearance(): UseAppearanceReturn {
  74 |     const appearance: Appearance = useSyncExternalStore(
  75 |         subscribe,
  76 |         () => currentAppearance,
  77 |         () => 'system',
  78 |     );
  79 | 
  80 |     const resolvedAppearance: ResolvedAppearance = useMemo(
  81 |         () => (isDarkMode(appearance) ? 'dark' : 'light'),
  82 |         [appearance],
  83 |     );
  84 | 
  85 |     const updateAppearance = useCallback((mode: Appearance): void => {
  86 |         currentAppearance = mode;
  87 | 
  88 |         // Store in localStorage for client-side persistence (no HTTP cookies)
  89 |         localStorage.setItem('appearance', mode);
  90 | 
  91 |         applyTheme(mode);
  92 |         notify();
  93 |     }, []);
  94 | 
  95 |     return { appearance, resolvedAppearance, updateAppearance } as const;
  96 | }

   1 | // Credit: https://usehooks-ts.com/
   2 | import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
   3 | 
   4 | export type CopiedValue = string | null;
   5 | export type CopyFn = (text: string) => Promise<boolean>;
   6 | export type UseClipboardReturn = [CopiedValue, CopyFn];
   7 | 
   8 | export function useClipboard(): UseClipboardReturn {
   9 |     const [copiedText, setCopiedText] = useState<CopiedValue>(null);
  10 | 
  11 |     const copy: CopyFn = useCallback(async (text) => {
  12 |         if (!navigator?.clipboard) {
  13 |             console.warn('Clipboard not supported');
  14 | 
  15 |             return false;
  16 |         }
  17 | 
  18 |         try {
  19 |             await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
  20 |             setCopiedText(text);
  21 | 
  22 |             return true;
  23 |         } catch (error) {
  24 |             console.warn('Copy failed', error);
  25 |             setCopiedText(null);
  26 | 
  27 |             return false;
  28 |         }
  29 |     }, []);
  30 | 
  31 |     return [copiedText, copy];
  32 | }

   1 | import type { InertiaLinkProps } from '@inertiajs/react';
   2 | import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/react';
   3 | import { toUrl } from '@/lib/utils';
   4 | 
   5 | export type IsCurrentUrlFn = (
   6 |     urlToCheck: NonNullable<InertiaLinkProps['href']>,
   7 |     currentUrl?: string,
   8 | ) => boolean;
   9 | 
  10 | export type WhenCurrentUrlFn = <TIfTrue, TIfFalse = null>(
  11 |     urlToCheck: NonNullable<InertiaLinkProps['href']>,
  12 |     ifTrue: TIfTrue,
  13 |     ifFalse?: TIfFalse,
  14 | ) => TIfTrue | TIfFalse;
  15 | 
  16 | export type UseCurrentUrlReturn = {
  17 |     currentUrl: string;
  18 |     isCurrentUrl: IsCurrentUrlFn;
  19 |     whenCurrentUrl: WhenCurrentUrlFn;
  20 | };
  21 | 
  22 | export function useCurrentUrl(): UseCurrentUrlReturn {
  23 |     const page = usePage();
  24 |     const currentUrlPath = new URL(page.url, window?.location.origin).pathname;
  25 | 
  26 |     const isCurrentUrl: IsCurrentUrlFn = (
  27 |         urlToCheck: NonNullable<InertiaLinkProps['href']>,
  28 |         currentUrl?: string,
  29 |     ) => {
  30 |         const urlToCompare = currentUrl ?? currentUrlPath;
  31 |         const urlString = toUrl(urlToCheck);
  32 | 
  33 |         if (!urlString.startsWith('http')) {
  34 |             return urlString === urlToCompare;
  35 |         }
  36 | 
  37 |         try {
  38 |             const absoluteUrl = new URL(urlString);
  39 |             return absoluteUrl.pathname === urlToCompare;
  40 |         } catch {
  41 |             return false;
  42 |         }
  43 |     };
  44 | 
  45 |     const whenCurrentUrl: WhenCurrentUrlFn = <TIfTrue, TIfFalse = null>(
  46 |         urlToCheck: NonNullable<InertiaLinkProps['href']>,
  47 |         ifTrue: TIfTrue,
  48 |         ifFalse: TIfFalse = null as TIfFalse,
  49 |     ): TIfTrue | TIfFalse => {
  50 |         return isCurrentUrl(urlToCheck) ? ifTrue : ifFalse;
  51 |     };
  52 | 
  53 |     return {
  54 |         currentUrl: currentUrlPath,
  55 |         isCurrentUrl,
  56 |         whenCurrentUrl,
  57 |     };
  58 | }

   1 | import { useCallback } from 'react';
   2 | 
   3 | export type GetInitialsFn = (fullName: string) => string;
   4 | 
   5 | export function useInitials(): GetInitialsFn {
   6 |     return useCallback((fullName: string): string => {
   7 |         const names = fullName.trim().split(' ');
   8 | 
   9 |         if (names.length === 0) return '';
  10 |         if (names.length === 1) return names[0].charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  11 | 
  12 |         const firstInitial = names[0].charAt(0);
  13 |         const lastInitial = names[names.length - 1].charAt(0);
  14 | 
  15 |         return `${firstInitial}${lastInitial}`.toUpperCase();
  16 |     }, []);
  17 | }

FILE #185: resources/js/hooks/use-live-sync.ts
Lines: 64 | Size: 2.3 KB
================================================================================

   1 | import { router, usePoll } from '@inertiajs/react';
   2 | import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
   3 | 
   4 | /**
   5 |  * useLiveSync
   6 |  *
   7 |  * Keeps Inertia page data continuously synchronized in the background without full page reloads:
   8 |  * 1. Automatically polls every `intervalMs` (default 5000ms) for the specified `only` prop keys.
   9 |  *    (Inertia automatically pauses polling when the browser tab is hidden/minimized to save server resources).
  10 |  * 2. Immediately triggers a partial reload when the browser window/tab regains focus or visibility,
  11 |  *    so switching between tabs (e.g. from an incognito data-encoder tab back to the admin tab)
  12 |  *    shows fresh data instantaneously without waiting for the polling timer to tick.
  13 |  *
  14 |  * @param intervalMs Polling interval in milliseconds (default: 5000ms)
  15 |  * @param only Array of Inertia prop keys to refresh (e.g. ['cases', 'stats'])
  16 |  * @param enabled Whether live sync is active (default: true)
  17 |  */
  18 | export function useLiveSync(
  19 |     intervalMs: number = 5000,
  20 |     only?: string[],
  21 |     enabled: boolean = true
  22 | ) {
  23 |     // 1. Regular background polling via Inertia v2
  24 |     usePoll(
  25 |         intervalMs,
  26 |         {
  27 |             only: only && only.length > 0 ? only : undefined,
  28 |         },
  29 |         {
  30 |             autoStart: enabled,
  31 |             keepAlive: false, // Pauses when tab is hidden to save server load
  32 |         }
  33 |     );
  34 | 
  35 |     const lastFocusRefreshRef = useRef<number>(0);
  36 |     const onlyKey = only ? only.join(',') : '';
  37 | 
  38 |     // 2. Instant partial reload when window regains focus or tab becomes visible
  39 |     useEffect(() => {
  40 |         if (!enabled) return;
  41 | 
  42 |         const handleFocusOrVisible = () => {
  43 |             if (document.hidden) return;
  44 | 
  45 |             // Throttle focus refreshes to at most once every 2.5 seconds
  46 |             const now = Date.now();
  47 |             if (now - lastFocusRefreshRef.current < 2500) return;
  48 |             lastFocusRefreshRef.current = now;
  49 | 
  50 |             router.reload({
  51 |                 only: only && only.length > 0 ? only : undefined,
  52 |             });
  53 |         };
  54 | 
  55 |         window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocusOrVisible);
  56 |         document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleFocusOrVisible);
  57 | 
  58 |         return () => {
  59 |             window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocusOrVisible);
  60 |             document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleFocusOrVisible);
  61 |         };
  62 |     }, [enabled, onlyKey]);
  63 | }
  64 |

   1 | import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
   2 | import { qrCode, recoveryCodes, secretKey } from '@/routes/two-factor';
   3 | import type { TwoFactorSecretKey, TwoFactorSetupData } from '@/types';
   4 | 
   5 | export type UseTwoFactorAuthReturn = {
   6 |     qrCodeSvg: string | null;
   7 |     manualSetupKey: string | null;
   8 |     recoveryCodesList: string[];
   9 |     hasSetupData: boolean;
  10 |     errors: string[];
  11 |     clearErrors: () => void;
  12 |     clearSetupData: () => void;
  13 |     fetchQrCode: () => Promise<void>;
  14 |     fetchSetupKey: () => Promise<void>;
  15 |     fetchSetupData: () => Promise<void>;
  16 |     fetchRecoveryCodes: () => Promise<void>;
  17 | };
  18 | 
  19 | export const OTP_MAX_LENGTH = 6;
  20 | 
  21 | const fetchJson = async <T>(url: string): Promise<T> => {
  22 |     const response = await fetch(url, {
  23 |         headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
  24 |     });
  25 | 
  26 |     if (!response.ok) {
  27 |         throw new Error(`Failed to fetch: ${response.status}`);
  28 |     }
  29 | 
  30 |     return response.json();
  31 | };
  32 | 
  33 | export const useTwoFactorAuth = (): UseTwoFactorAuthReturn => {
  34 |     const [qrCodeSvg, setQrCodeSvg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  35 |     const [manualSetupKey, setManualSetupKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  36 |     const [recoveryCodesList, setRecoveryCodesList] = useState<string[]>([]);
  37 |     const [errors, setErrors] = useState<string[]>([]);
  38 | 
  39 |     const hasSetupData = useMemo<boolean>(
  40 |         () => qrCodeSvg !== null && manualSetupKey !== null,
  41 |         [qrCodeSvg, manualSetupKey],
  42 |     );
  43 | 
  44 |     const fetchQrCode = useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
  45 |         try {
  46 |             const { svg } = await fetchJson<TwoFactorSetupData>(qrCode.url());
  47 |             setQrCodeSvg(svg);
  48 |         } catch {
  49 |             setErrors((prev) => [...prev, 'Failed to fetch QR code']);
  50 |             setQrCodeSvg(null);
  51 |         }
  52 |     }, []);
  53 | 
  54 |     const fetchSetupKey = useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
  55 |         try {
  56 |             const { secretKey: key } = await fetchJson<TwoFactorSecretKey>(
  57 |                 secretKey.url(),
  58 |             );
  59 |             setManualSetupKey(key);
  60 |         } catch {
  61 |             setErrors((prev) => [...prev, 'Failed to fetch a setup key']);
  62 |             setManualSetupKey(null);
  63 |         }
  64 |     }, []);
  65 | 
  66 |     const clearErrors = useCallback((): void => {
  67 |         setErrors([]);
  68 |     }, []);
  69 | 
  70 |     const clearSetupData = useCallback((): void => {
  71 |         setManualSetupKey(null);
  72 |         setQrCodeSvg(null);
  73 |         clearErrors();
  74 |     }, [clearErrors]);
  75 | 
  76 |     const fetchRecoveryCodes = useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
  77 |         try {
  78 |             clearErrors();
  79 |             const codes = await fetchJson<string[]>(recoveryCodes.url());
  80 |             setRecoveryCodesList(codes);
  81 |         } catch {
  82 |             setErrors((prev) => [...prev, 'Failed to fetch recovery codes']);
  83 |             setRecoveryCodesList([]);
  84 |         }
  85 |     }, [clearErrors]);
  86 | 
  87 |     const fetchSetupData = useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
  88 |         try {
  89 |             clearErrors();
  90 |             await Promise.all([fetchQrCode(), fetchSetupKey()]);
  91 |         } catch {
  92 |             setQrCodeSvg(null);
  93 |             setManualSetupKey(null);
  94 |         }
  95 |     }, [clearErrors, fetchQrCode, fetchSetupKey]);
  96 | 
  97 |     return {
  98 |         qrCodeSvg,
  99 |         manualSetupKey,
 100 |         recoveryCodesList,
 101 |         hasSetupData,
 102 |         errors,
 103 |         clearErrors,
 104 |         clearSetupData,
 105 |         fetchQrCode,
 106 |         fetchSetupKey,
 107 |         fetchSetupData,
 108 |         fetchRecoveryCodes,
 109 |     };
 110 | };

 300 |                                                                     if (log.module === 'System Kernel' || log.module === 'Database System') return 'System Process';
 301 |                                                                     if (log.module === 'React UI Interface') return 'Client Browser';
 302 |                                                                     
 303 |                                                                     return 'System / Unknown';
 304 |                                                                 })()}
 305 |                                                             </div>
 306 |                                                             <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{log.user?.role || ''}</div>
 307 |                                                         </div>
 308 |                                                     </div>
 309 |                                                 </TableCell>
 310 |                                                 <TableCell>
 311 |                                                     <Badge variant="outline" className={`
 312 |                                                         ${log.action === 'CREATE' ? 'bg-green-50 text-green-700 border-green-200' : ''}
 313 |                                                         ${log.action === 'UPDATE' ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200' : ''}
 314 |                                                         ${log.action === 'DELETE' ? 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200' : ''}
 315 |                                                         ${['PAGE_NOT_FOUND', 'DATABASE_ERROR', 'VALIDATION_FAILED', 'SYSTEM_ERROR', 'FRONTEND_ERROR', 'ACCESS_DENIED', 'ERROR'].includes(log.action) ? 'bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border-destructive/20' : ''}
 316 |                                                     `}>
 317 |                                                         {log.action}
 318 |                                                     </Badge>
 319 |                                                 </TableCell>

 322 |                                                     {log.details}

 325 |                                             </TableRow>
 326 |                                         ))
 327 |                                     )}
 328 |                                 </TableBody>
 329 |                             </Table>
 330 |                         </div>

 116 | function formatDateWithoutShift(dateStr?: string | null) {
 117 |     if (!dateStr) return 'N/A';
 118 |     const cleanDate = dateStr.split('T')[0];
 119 |     const parts = cleanDate.split('-');
 120 |     if (parts.length === 3 && parts[0].length === 4) {
 121 |         const year = Number(parts[0]);
 122 |         const month = Number(parts[1]) - 1;
 123 |         const day = Number(parts[2]);
 124 |         const localDate = new Date(year, month, day);
 125 |         return localDate.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' });
 126 |     }
 127 |     const d = new Date(dateStr);
 128 |     return !isNaN(d.getTime()) ? d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' }) : dateStr;
 129 | }
 130 | 
 131 | function normalizeDateToISO(val: string): string {
 132 |     if (!val) return '';
 133 |     if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(val)) return val;
 134 |     const parts = val.split(/[\/\-]/);
 135 |     if (parts.length === 3) {
 136 |         if (parts[2].length === 4) {
 137 |             const m = parts[0].padStart(2, '0');
 138 |             const d = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
 139 |             const y = parts[2];
 140 |             return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
 141 |         } else if (parts[0].length === 4) {
 142 |             const y = parts[0];
 143 |             const m = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
 144 |             const d = parts[2].padStart(2, '0');
 145 |             return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
 146 |         }
 147 |     }
 148 |     return val;
 149 | }

 218 |     const updateSearch = useCallback(

 233 |     const applyDateFilter = useCallback(
 234 |         debounce((isoDate: string) => {

 238 |                     search,
 239 |                     status,
 240 |                     nature,
 241 |                     date: isoDate,

 246 |                     ...(filters.doc_title ? { doc_title: filters.doc_title } : {}),
 247 |                 },
 248 |                 { preserveState: true, replace: true }
 249 |             );
 250 |         }, 300),
 251 |         [search, status, nature, month, sortField, sortOrder, filters.doc_type, filters.doc_title]

 263 |     const handleFilterChange = (key: string, value: string) => {

 277 |         if (key === 'month') {

 282 |                 newDate = '';
 283 |             }
 284 |         }
 285 | 
 286 |         router.get(
 287 |             '/cases',
 288 |             {
 289 |                 search,
 290 |                 status: key === 'status' ? value : status,
 291 |                 nature: key === 'nature' ? value : nature,
 292 |                 date: newDate,
 293 |                 month: newMonth,
 294 |                 sort_by: sortField,
 295 |                 sort_order: sortOrder,
 296 |                 ...(filters.doc_type ? { doc_type: filters.doc_type } : {}),
 297 |                 ...(filters.doc_title ? { doc_title: filters.doc_title } : {}),
 298 |             },
 299 |             { preserveState: true, replace: true }
 300 |         );
 301 |     };

 308 |         router.get(
 309 |             '/cases',
 310 |             {
 311 |                 search,
 312 |                 status,
 313 |                 nature,
 314 |                 date,
 315 |                 month,
 316 |                 sort_by: field,
 317 |                 sort_order: newOrder,
 318 |             },
 319 |             { preserveState: true, replace: true }
 320 |         );
 321 |     };

  67 | // ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  68 | const getTemplateTitle = (type: string) => {
  69 |     if (type === 'uploaded' || type === 'upload') return 'Uploaded Document';
  70 |     if (type === 'custom_form' || type === 'custom') return 'Custom Form';
  71 |     const template = TEMPLATES.find(t => t.type === type);
  72 |     return template ? template.title : type.replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase());
  73 | };

 301 |     // Handle initial scanned file upload to Gemini API
 302 |     const handleFileUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
 303 |         const file = e.target.files?.[0];
 304 |         if (!file) return;
 305 | 
 306 |         // Reset file input value so re-selecting the same file triggers onChange
 307 |         e.target.value = '';
 308 | 
 309 |         // Proactive offline check
 310 |         if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && !navigator.onLine) {
 311 |             setIsOffline(true);
 312 |             setScanError('No internet connection detected. Gemini AI optical scanning requires network access. Please use manual form entry below.');
 313 |             return;
 314 |         }
 315 | 
 316 |         setIsScanning(true);
 317 |         setScanError(null);
 318 | 
 319 |         const formData = new FormData();
 320 |         formData.append('file', file);
 321 | 
 322 |         try {
 323 |             // Read the encrypted XSRF-TOKEN cookie set by Laravel.
 324 |             // This is updated on every request and is always fresh, avoiding stale token issues from Inertia navigation.
 325 |             const getXsrfToken = (): string => {
 326 |                 const name = 'XSRF-TOKEN';
 327 |                 const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
 328 |                 const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
 329 |                 if (parts.length === 2) {
 330 |                     return decodeURIComponent(parts.pop()?.split(';').shift() || '');
 331 |                 }
 332 |                 return '';
 333 |             };
 334 | 
 335 |             const xsrfToken = getXsrfToken();
 336 |             const res = await fetch('/documents/upload', {
 337 |                 method: 'POST',
 338 |                 headers: {
 339 |                     'Accept': 'application/json',
 340 |                     'X-XSRF-TOKEN': xsrfToken,
 341 |                 },
 342 |                 body: formData
 343 |             });
 344 | 
 345 |             let result;
 346 |             try {
 347 |                 result = await res.json();
 348 |             } catch (jsonErr) {
 349 |                 throw new Error(`Server returned an invalid response (Status ${res.status}). Please verify that your uploaded file size does not exceed the server's upload limit.`);
 350 |             }
 351 | 
 352 |             if (result.quota_exceeded || res.status === 429) {
 353 |                 if (result.quota) {
 354 |                     setQuotaState(result.quota);
 355 |                 } else {
 356 |                     setQuotaState(prev => ({ ...prev, isExceeded: true, used: 20 }));
 357 |                 }
 358 |                 setScanError(result.message || 'Weekly AI upload limit reached (20/20 files used). Please manually fill up your complaint or affidavit of withdrawal form.');
 359 |                 return;
 360 |             }
 361 | 
 362 |             if (res.ok && result.success) {
 363 |                 const data = result.data || {};
 364 | 
 365 |                 // Verify that the AI actually extracted readable content
 366 |                 const hasReadableText = Boolean(
 367 |                     (data.complainant && data.complainant.trim()) ||
 368 |                     (data.respondent && data.respondent.trim()) ||
 369 |                     (data.case_no && data.case_no.trim()) ||
 370 |                     (data.summary && data.summary.trim())
 371 |                 );
 372 | 
 373 |                 if (!hasReadableText) {
 374 |                     throw new Error('The AI was unable to read or recognize any legible text from the uploaded document. Please check the scan quality or enter details manually.');
 375 |                 }
 376 | 
 377 |                 // Successful read — reset failed attempts
 378 |                 setScanAttempts(0);
 379 |                 setTempFilePath(result.temp_file);
 380 |                 if (result.assigned_folder) {
 381 |                     setAssignedFolder(result.assigned_folder);
 382 |                 }
 383 |                 
 384 |                 // Pre-fill editable inputs with AI-extracted values
 385 |                 setComplainant(data.complainant || '');
 386 |                 setRespondent(data.respondent || '');
 387 |                 setCaseNo(data.case_no || '');
 388 |                 setNatureOfCase(data.nature_of_case || '');
 389 |                 setSummary(data.summary || '');
 390 |                 
 391 |                 // Map document_type to nearest enum
 392 |                 if (data.document_type) {
 393 |                     setDocType(data.document_type);
 394 |                 }
 395 |             } else {
 396 |                 const rawMsg = result.message || 'Failed to scan the document. Please try again.';
 397 |                 if (rawMsg.includes('Could not resolve host') || rawMsg.includes('cURL error') || rawMsg.includes('Internet connection required') || rawMsg.includes('Failed to fetch')) {
 398 |                     setIsOffline(true);
 399 |                     throw new Error('Internet connection required for Gemini AI metadata extraction. Please check your network or enter data manually.');
 400 |                 } else {
 401 |                     throw new Error(rawMsg);
 402 |                 }
 403 |             }
 404 |         } catch (err: any) {
 405 |             const nextAttempts = scanAttempts + 1;
 406 |             setScanAttempts(nextAttempts);
 407 | 
 408 |             const msg = err?.message || '';
 409 |             if (
 410 |                 (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && !navigator.onLine) ||
 411 |                 msg.includes('Failed to fetch') ||
 412 |                 msg.includes('NetworkError') ||
 413 |                 msg.includes('Could not resolve host') ||
 414 |                 msg.includes('network')
 415 |             ) {
 416 |                 setIsOffline(true);
 417 |                 setScanError('Internet connection required for Gemini AI metadata extraction. Please check your network or enter data manually.');
 418 |             } else {
 419 |                 setScanError(msg || 'An error occurred during scanning.');
 420 |             }
 421 |         } finally {
 422 |             setIsScanning(false);
 423 |         }
 424 |     };

 289 |                 isToday: dateStr === new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],

 292 |                 hasPhase: timeline.some((p) => dateStr >= p.start_date && dateStr <= p.end_date),

  48 | export default function SettingsPage({ initialDeadline }: { initialDeadline?: string }) {
  49 |     const breadcrumbs = [
  50 |         {
  51 |             title: 'Settings',
  52 |             href: '/settings',
  53 |         },
  54 |     ];
  55 | 
  56 |     const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('general');
  57 |     const [deadlineDate, setDeadlineDate] = useState(initialDeadline || '');
  58 |     const [isSavingDeadline, setIsSavingDeadline] = useState(false);
  59 |     const [deadlineMsg, setDeadlineMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  60 | 
  61 |     const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  62 |     const [isRestoring, setIsRestoring] = useState(false);
  63 |     const [restoreMsg, setRestoreMsg] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);
  64 | 
  65 |     const handleDownloadBackup = () => {
  66 |         window.location.href = '/settings/backup/download';
  67 |     };
  68 | 
  69 |     const handleTriggerRestore = () => {
  70 |         setRestoreMsg(null);
  71 |         fileInputRef.current?.click();
  72 |     };
  73 | 
  74 |     const handleRestoreFileSelected = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
  75 |         const file = e.target.files?.[0];
  76 |         if (!file) return;
  77 | 
  78 |         setRestoreMsg(null);
  79 | 
  80 |         if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to restore database records from file "${file.name}"? Existing data will be updated.`)) {
  81 |             if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
  82 |             return;
  83 |         }
  84 | 
  85 |         setIsRestoring(true);
  86 |         const formData = new FormData();
  87 |         formData.append('backup_file', file);
  88 | 
  89 |         router.post('/settings/backup/restore', formData, {
  90 |             onSuccess: (page) => {
  91 |                 const pageProps = page.props as any;
  92 |                 const flashErr = pageProps?.flash?.error;
  93 |                 const validationErr = pageProps?.errors?.backup_file;
  94 |                 const flashSucc = pageProps?.flash?.success;
  95 |                 
  96 |                 if (flashErr || validationErr) {
  97 |                     setRestoreMsg({ type: 'error', text: flashErr || validationErr });
  98 |                 } else if (flashSucc) {
  99 |                     setRestoreMsg({ type: 'success', text: flashSucc });
 100 |                     setTimeout(() => setRestoreMsg(null), 6000);
 101 |                 } else {
 102 |                     setRestoreMsg({ type: 'error', text: 'Database restore could not be confirmed by the server.' });
 103 |                 }
 104 |             },
 105 |             onError: (errs) => {
 106 |                 setRestoreMsg({ type: 'error', text: errs.backup_file || errs.error || 'Security rejected: Only .json database backup packages generated by Lupon are accepted.' });
 107 |             },
 108 |             onFinish: () => {
 109 |                 setIsRestoring(false);
 110 |                 if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
 111 |             }
 112 |         });
 113 |     };
 114 | 
 115 |     const handleSaveDeadline = (e: React.FormEvent) => {

 137 |     };

 100 | update.url = (args: { role: number | { id: number } } | [role: number | { id: number } ] | number | { id: number }, options?: RouteQueryOptions) => {
 101 |     if (typeof args === 'string' || typeof args === 'number') {
 102 |         args = { role: args }
 103 |     }
 104 | 
 105 |             if (typeof args === 'object' && !Array.isArray(args) && 'id' in args) {
 106 |             args = { role: args.id }
 107 |         }
 108 |     
 109 |     if (Array.isArray(args)) {
 110 |         args = {
 111 |                     role: args[0],
 112 |                 }
 113 |     }
 114 | 
 115 |     args = applyUrlDefaults(args)
 116 | 
 117 |     const parsedArgs = {
 118 |                         role: typeof args.role === 'object'
 119 |                 ? args.role.id
 120 |                 : args.role,
 121 |                 }
 122 | 
 123 |     return update.definition.url
 124 |             .replace('{role}', parsedArgs.role.toString())
 125 |             .replace(/\/+$/, '') + queryParams(options)

   1 | export type QueryParams = {
   2 |     [key: string]:
   3 |         | string
   4 |         | number
   5 |         | boolean
   6 |         | (string | number)[]
   7 |         | null
   8 |         | undefined
   9 |         | QueryParams;
  10 | };
  11 | 
  12 | type Method = "get" | "post" | "put" | "delete" | "patch" | "head" | "options";
  13 | type UrlDefaults = Record<string, unknown>;
  14 | 
  15 | let urlDefaults: () => UrlDefaults = () => ({});
  16 | 
  17 | export type RouteDefinition<TMethod extends Method | Method[]> = {
  18 |     url: string;
  19 | } & (TMethod extends Method[] ? { methods: TMethod } : { method: TMethod });
  20 | 
  21 | export type RouteFormDefinition<TMethod extends Method> = {
  22 |     action: string;
  23 |     method: TMethod;
  24 | };
  25 | 
  26 | export type RouteQueryOptions = {
  27 |     query?: QueryParams;
  28 |     mergeQuery?: QueryParams;
  29 | };
  30 | 
  31 | const getValue = (value: string | number | boolean) => {
  32 |     if (value === true) {
  33 |         return "1";
  34 |     }
  35 | 
  36 |     if (value === false) {
  37 |         return "0";
  38 |     }
  39 | 
  40 |     return value.toString();
  41 | };
  42 | 
  43 | const addNestedParams = (
  44 |     obj: QueryParams,
  45 |     prefix: string,
  46 |     params: URLSearchParams,
  47 | ) => {
  48 |     Object.entries(obj).forEach(([subKey, value]) => {
  49 |         if (value === undefined) return;
  50 | 
  51 |         const paramKey = `${prefix}[${subKey}]`;
  52 | 
  53 |         if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  54 |             value.forEach((v) => params.append(`${paramKey}[]`, getValue(v)));
  55 |         } else if (value !== null && typeof value === "object") {
  56 |             addNestedParams(value, paramKey, params);
  57 |         } else if (["string", "number", "boolean"].includes(typeof value)) {
  58 |             params.set(paramKey, getValue(value as string | number | boolean));
  59 |         }
  60 |     });
  61 | };
  62 | 
  63 | export const queryParams = (options?: RouteQueryOptions) => {
  64 |     if (!options || (!options.query && !options.mergeQuery)) {
  65 |         return "";
  66 |     }
  67 | 
  68 |     const query = options.query ?? options.mergeQuery;
  69 |     const includeExisting = options.mergeQuery !== undefined;
  70 | 
  71 |     const params = new URLSearchParams(
  72 |         includeExisting && typeof window !== "undefined"
  73 |             ? window.location.search
  74 |             : "",
  75 |     );
  76 | 
  77 |     for (const key in query) {
  78 |         const queryValue = query[key];
  79 | 
  80 |         if (queryValue === undefined || queryValue === null) {
  81 |             params.delete(key);
  82 |             continue;
  83 |         }
  84 | 
  85 |         if (Array.isArray(queryValue)) {
  86 |             if (params.has(`${key}[]`)) {
  87 |                 params.delete(`${key}[]`);
  88 |             }
  89 | 
  90 |             queryValue.forEach((value) => {
  91 |                 params.append(`${key}[]`, value.toString());
  92 |             });
  93 |         } else if (typeof queryValue === "object") {
  94 |             params.forEach((_, paramKey) => {
  95 |                 if (paramKey.startsWith(`${key}[`)) {
  96 |                     params.delete(paramKey);
  97 |                 }
  98 |             });
  99 | 
 100 |             addNestedParams(queryValue, key, params);
 101 |         } else {
 102 |             params.set(key, getValue(queryValue));
 103 |         }
 104 |     }
 105 | 
 106 |     const str = params.toString();
 107 | 
 108 |     return str.length > 0 ? `?${str}` : "";
 109 | };
 110 | 
 111 | export const setUrlDefaults = (params: UrlDefaults | (() => UrlDefaults)) => {
 112 |     urlDefaults = typeof params === "function" ? params : () => params;
 113 | };
 114 | 
 115 | export const addUrlDefault = (
 116 |     key: string,
 117 |     value: string | number | boolean,
 118 | ) => {
 119 |     const params = urlDefaults();
 120 |     params[key] = value;
 121 | 
 122 |     urlDefaults = () => params;
 123 | };
 124 | 
 125 | export const applyUrlDefaults = <T extends UrlDefaults | undefined>(
 126 |     existing: T,
 127 | ): T => {
 128 |     const existingParams = { ...(existing ?? ({} as UrlDefaults)) };
 129 |     const defaultParams = urlDefaults();
 130 | 
 131 |     for (const key in defaultParams) {
 132 |         if (
 133 |             existingParams[key] === undefined &&
 134 |             defaultParams[key] !== undefined
 135 |         ) {
 136 |             (existingParams as Record<string, unknown>)[key] =
 137 |                 defaultParams[key];
 138 |         }
 139 |     }
 140 | 
 141 |     return existingParams as T;
 142 | };
 143 | 
 144 | export const validateParameters = (
 145 |     args: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
 146 |     optional: string[],
 147 | ) => {
 148 |     const missing = optional.filter((key) => !args?.[key]);
 149 |     const expectedMissing = optional.slice(missing.length * -1);
 150 | 
 151 |     for (let i = 0; i < missing.length; i++) {
 152 |         if (missing[i] !== expectedMissing[i]) {
 153 |             throw Error(
 154 |                 "Unexpected optional parameters missing. Unable to generate a URL.",
 155 |             );
 156 |         }
 157 |     }
 158 | };

1856 |     function getOrdinalDay(day) {
1857 |         const d = parseInt(day, 10);
1858 |         if (isNaN(d)) return day;
1859 |         if (d > 3 && d < 21) return d + 'th';
1860 |         switch (d % 10) {
1861 |             case 1:  return d + 'st';
1862 |             case 2:  return d + 'nd';
1863 |             case 3:  return d + 'rd';
1864 |             default: return d + 'th';
1865 |         }
1866 |     }
1867 | 
1868 |     function update12HourTimeField(fieldName) {
1869 |         const hEl = document.getElementById('hearing-hour-' + fieldName);
1870 |         const mEl = document.getElementById('hearing-minute-' + fieldName);
1871 |         const apEl = document.getElementById('hearing-ampm-' + fieldName);
1872 |         const targetInput = document.getElementById('field-' + fieldName);
1873 |         const displayEl = document.getElementById('hearing-time-display-' + fieldName);
1874 | 
1875 |         if (!hEl || !targetInput) return;
1876 | 
1877 |         const hour = hEl.value;
1878 |         const minute = (mEl && mEl.value !== '') ? mEl.value : '00';
1879 |         const ampm = (apEl && apEl.value) ? apEl.value : 'AM';
1880 | 
1881 |         if (hour) {
1882 |             const formattedTime = hour + ':' + minute + ' ' + ampm;
1883 |             targetInput.value = formattedTime;
1884 |             if (displayEl) {
1885 |                 displayEl.textContent = formattedTime;
1886 |                 displayEl.style.color = '#1d4ed8';
1887 |             }
1888 |         } else {
1889 |             targetInput.value = '';
1890 |             if (displayEl) {
1891 |                 displayEl.textContent = 'Not selected';
1892 |                 displayEl.style.color = '#64748b';
1893 |             }
1894 |         }
1895 | 
1896 |         updatePreview(fieldName, targetInput.value);
1897 |         targetInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
1898 |     }

1900 |     function updateCombinedHearingDateTime(fieldName) {
1901 |         const dateEl = document.getElementById('date-picker-' + fieldName);
1902 |         const hEl = document.getElementById('time-hour-' + fieldName);
1903 |         const mEl = document.getElementById('time-min-' + fieldName);
1904 |         const apEl = document.getElementById('time-ampm-' + fieldName);
1905 |         const targetInput = document.getElementById('field-' + fieldName);
1906 |         const displayEl = document.getElementById('date-time-display-' + fieldName);
1907 | 
1908 |         if (!targetInput) return;
1909 | 
1910 |         let dateStr = '';
1911 |         if (dateEl && dateEl.value) {
1912 |             const d = new Date(dateEl.value + 'T00:00:00');
1913 |             if (!isNaN(d)) {
1914 |                 dateStr = MONTH_NAMES[d.getMonth()] + ' ' + d.getDate() + ', ' + d.getFullYear();
1915 |             }
1916 |         }
1917 | 
1918 |         let timeStr = '';
1919 |         if (hEl && hEl.value) {
1920 |             const hour = hEl.value;
1921 |             const minute = (mEl && mEl.value !== '') ? mEl.value : '00';
1922 |             const ampm = (apEl && apEl.value) ? apEl.value : 'AM';
1923 |             timeStr = hour + ':' + minute + ' ' + ampm;
1924 |         }
1925 | 
1926 |         let combined = '';
1927 |         if (dateStr && timeStr) {
1928 |             combined = dateStr + ' at ' + timeStr;
1929 |         } else if (dateStr) {
1930 |             combined = dateStr;
1931 |         } else if (timeStr) {
1932 |             combined = timeStr;
1933 |         }
1934 | 
1935 |         targetInput.value = combined;
1936 |         if (displayEl) {
1937 |             displayEl.textContent = combined || 'Select date & time above';
1938 |             displayEl.style.color = combined ? '#0f172a' : '#64748b';
1939 |         }
1940 | 
1941 |         updatePreview(fieldName, targetInput.value);
1942 |         targetInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
1943 |     }

1996 |     function initAllHearingControls() {
1997 |         // 1. Initialize dedicated 12-hour time fields
1998 |         document.querySelectorAll('[id^="hearing-hour-"]').forEach(hEl => {
1999 |             const fieldName = hEl.id.replace('hearing-hour-', '');
2000 |             const targetInput = document.getElementById('field-' + fieldName);
2001 |             if (!targetInput || !targetInput.value.trim()) return;
2002 | 
2003 |             const val = targetInput.value.trim();
2004 |             const mEl = document.getElementById('hearing-minute-' + fieldName);
2005 |             const apEl = document.getElementById('hearing-ampm-' + fieldName);
2006 | 
2007 |             // Pattern A: "9:00 AM", "09:30 PM", "9:00am"
2008 |             let match = val.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)/i);
2009 |             if (match) {
2010 |                 hEl.value = parseInt(match[1], 10);
2011 |                 if (mEl) mEl.value = match[2];
2012 |                 if (apEl) apEl.value = match[3].toUpperCase();
2013 |                 update12HourTimeField(fieldName);
2014 |                 return;
2015 |             }
2016 | 
2017 |             // Pattern B: "14:30" (24-hour military)
2018 |             match = val.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/);
2019 |             if (match) {
2020 |                 let h = parseInt(match[1], 10);
2021 |                 const m = match[2];
2022 |                 const ap = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
2023 |                 h = h % 12 || 12;
2024 |                 hEl.value = h;
2025 |                 if (mEl) mEl.value = m;
2026 |                 if (apEl) apEl.value = ap;
2027 |                 update12HourTimeField(fieldName);
2028 |                 return;
2029 |             }
2030 | 
2031 |             // Pattern C: "1000", "0900" (4-digit military)
2032 |             match = val.match(/^(\d{2})(\d{2})$/);
2033 |             if (match) {
2034 |                 let h = parseInt(match[1], 10);
2035 |                 const m = match[2];
2036 |                 const ap = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
2037 |                 h = h % 12 || 12;
2038 |                 hEl.value = h;
2039 |                 if (mEl) mEl.value = m;
2040 |                 if (apEl) apEl.value = ap;
2041 |                 update12HourTimeField(fieldName);
2042 |                 return;
2043 |             }
2044 |         });
2045 | 
2046 |         // 2. Initialize combined hearing date & time fields
2047 |         document.querySelectorAll('[id^="date-picker-hearing_"], [id^="date-picker-first_session_"], [id^="date-picker-field_"]').forEach(dateEl => {
2048 |             const fieldName = dateEl.id.replace('date-picker-', '');
2049 |             const targetInput = document.getElementById('field-' + fieldName);
2050 |             if (!targetInput || !targetInput.value.trim()) return;
2051 | 
2052 |             const val = targetInput.value.trim();
2053 |             const hEl = document.getElementById('time-hour-' + fieldName);
2054 |             const mEl = document.getElementById('time-min-' + fieldName);
2055 |             const apEl = document.getElementById('time-ampm-' + fieldName);
2056 | 
2057 |             // Extract time part: "at 9:00 AM" or "9:00 AM"
2058 |             const timeMatch = val.match(/at\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)/i) || val.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)/i);
2059 |             if (timeMatch && hEl) {
2060 |                 hEl.value = parseInt(timeMatch[1], 10);
2061 |                 if (mEl) mEl.value = timeMatch[2];
2062 |                 if (apEl) apEl.value = timeMatch[3].toUpperCase();
2063 |             }
2064 | 
2065 |             // Extract date part: remove "at ..."
2066 |             const cleanDate = val.replace(/at\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s*(AM|PM).*/i, '').trim();
2067 |             if (cleanDate) {
2068 |                 const parsed = new Date(cleanDate);
2069 |                 if (!isNaN(parsed) && parsed.getFullYear() > 1900) {
2070 |                     const y = parsed.getFullYear();
2071 |                     const m = String(parsed.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
2072 |                     const d = String(parsed.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
2073 |                     dateEl.value = `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
2074 |                 }
2075 |             }
2076 | 
2077 |             updateCombinedHearingDateTime(fieldName);
2078 |         });
2079 | 
2080 |         // 3. Pre-fill split hearing date picker if values already present
2081 |         const sMonth = document.getElementById('field-hearing_month');
2082 |         const sDay = document.getElementById('field-hearing_day');
2083 |         const sYear = document.getElementById('field-hearing_year');
2084 |         const splitPicker = document.getElementById('hearing-split-date-picker');
2085 |         if (splitPicker && sMonth && sDay && sYear && sMonth.value && sDay.value) {
2086 |             const mIdx = MONTH_NAMES.findIndex(m => m.toLowerCase() === sMonth.value.trim().toLowerCase());
2087 |             const dNum = parseInt(sDay.value.replace(/\D/g, ''), 10);
2088 |             let yNum = parseInt(sYear.value.replace(/\D/g, ''), 10);
2089 |             if (yNum < 100) yNum += 2000;
2090 |             if (mIdx >= 0 && dNum > 0 && yNum > 1900) {
2091 |                 const mStr = String(mIdx + 1).padStart(2, '0');
2092 |                 const dStr = String(dNum).padStart(2, '0');
2093 |                 splitPicker.value = `${yNum}-${mStr}-${dStr}`;
2094 |             }
2095 |         }
2096 | 
2097 |         // 4. Pre-fill next hearing date picker
2098 |         const nDate = document.getElementById('field-next_hearing_date');
2099 |         const nYear = document.getElementById('field-next_hearing_year');
2100 |         const nextPicker = document.getElementById('next-hearing-date-picker');
2101 |         if (nextPicker && nDate && nYear && nDate.value && nYear.value) {
2102 |             const parsed = new Date(nDate.value + ' ' + nYear.value);
2103 |             if (!isNaN(parsed) && parsed.getFullYear() > 1900) {
2104 |                 const y = parsed.getFullYear();
2105 |                 const m = String(parsed.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
2106 |                 const d = String(parsed.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
2107 |                 nextPicker.value = `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
2108 |             }
2109 |         }
2110 |     }

2183 |                 : 'Are you sure you want to generate & save this document?';
