2252 |     function doSaveFormOnly() {
2253 |         const overridesEl = document.getElementById('layout-overrides');
2254 |         if (overridesEl) overridesEl.value = JSON.stringify(buildLayoutOverrides());
2255 | 
2256 |         const actionInput = document.querySelector('input[name="action"]');
2257 |         if (actionInput) actionInput.value = 'save_only';
2258 | 
2259 |         const loader = document.getElementById('loaderOverlay');
2260 |         const loaderText = document.querySelector('.loader-text');
2261 |         if (loader) loader.classList.add('active');
2262 |         if (loaderText) loaderText.innerText = 'Saving...';
2263 | 
2264 |         const form = document.getElementById('doc-form');
2265 |         const formData = new FormData(form);
2266 | 
2267 |         fetch(form.getAttribute('action'), {
2268 |             method: 'POST',
2269 |             body: formData,
2270 |             headers: {
2271 |                 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
2272 |             }
2273 |         })
2274 |         .then(response => response.json())
2275 |         .then(data => {
2276 |             if (loader) loader.classList.remove('active');
2277 |             if (loaderText) loaderText.innerText = 'Generating PDF...'; // reset loader text
2278 |             if (data && data.success) {
2279 |                 alert('Success! ' + (data.message || 'Document saved successfully.'));
2280 |                 window.location.href = '/cases';
2281 |             } else {
2282 |                 alert('Error: ' + ((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Could not save form.'));
2283 |                 if (actionInput) actionInput.value = 'preview'; // restore default
2284 |             }
2285 |         })
2286 |         .catch(err => {
2287 |             if (loader) loader.classList.remove('active');
2288 |             if (loaderText) loaderText.innerText = 'Generating PDF...'; // reset loader text
2289 |             if (actionInput) actionInput.value = 'preview'; // restore default
2290 |             console.error(err);
2291 |             alert('Failed to save document. Please try again.');
2292 |         });
2293 |     }

2347 |     function downloadWord() {
2348 |         const wordForm = document.getElementById('word-form');
2349 | 
2350 |         // Remove any previously injected value inputs
2351 |         wordForm.querySelectorAll('.injected-field').forEach(el => el.remove());
2352 | 
2353 |         // Copy all filled values from the main form into the word-form
2354 |         document.querySelectorAll('#doc-form .form-input, #doc-form .form-textarea').forEach(el => {
2355 |             if (el.name && el.value.trim() !== '') {
2356 |                 const hidden = document.createElement('input');
2357 |                 hidden.type  = 'hidden';
2358 |                 hidden.name  = el.name;
2359 |                 hidden.value = el.value;
2360 |                 hidden.classList.add('injected-field');
2361 |                 wordForm.appendChild(hidden);
2362 |             }
2363 |         });
2364 | 
2365 |         // Copy checked checkboxes
2366 |         document.querySelectorAll('#doc-form input[type="checkbox"]:checked').forEach(cb => {
2367 |             const hidden = document.createElement('input');
2368 |             hidden.type  = 'hidden';
2369 |             hidden.name  = cb.name;
2370 |             hidden.value = cb.value;
2371 |             hidden.classList.add('injected-field');
2372 |             wordForm.appendChild(hidden);
2373 |         });
2374 | 
2375 |         // Submit — browser will prompt to open/save the .docx
2376 |         wordForm.submit();
2377 |     }

2532 | <script>
2533 | // ===== CALIBRATION SYSTEM =======================================================
2534 | // NOTE: paper dimensions are read live from the DOM (paper.offsetWidth/Height)
2535 | // so positions are always accurate regardless of screen size or zoom level.
2536 | 
2537 | // Current calibrated positions (name → {x%, y%})
2538 | let calibPositions = {};
2539 | let calibHistory = []; // Tracks undo state
2540 | let currentFontSize = 11; // Editor Base default font size
2541 | 
2542 | function execCmd(command, value = null) {
2543 |     document.execCommand(command, false, value);
2544 | }
2545 | 
2546 | function applyFontFamily(fontName) {
2547 |     document.execCommand('fontName', false, fontName);
2548 |     const sel = window.getSelection();
2549 |     if (sel && sel.anchorNode) {
2550 |         const parent = sel.anchorNode.parentElement;
2551 |         if (parent && parent.classList.contains('calib-field-text')) {
2552 |             parent.style.fontFamily = fontName;
2553 |         }
2554 |     }
2555 | }
2556 | 
2557 | function setZoom(val) {
2558 |     const paper = document.getElementById('calibPaper');
2559 |     if (paper) {
2560 |         paper.style.transform = `scale(${val / 100})`;
2561 |         paper.style.transformOrigin = 'top center';
2562 |     }
2563 | }
2564 | 
2565 | function increaseFontSize() {
2566 |     changeFontSize(1);
2567 | }
2568 | 
2569 | function decreaseFontSize() {
2570 |     changeFontSize(-1);
2571 | }
2572 | 
2573 | function setNumericFontSize(size) {
2574 |     let pt = parseInt(size, 10);
2575 |     if (isNaN(pt)) return;
2576 |     currentFontSize = Math.max(8, Math.min(72, pt));
2577 |     document.getElementById('toolbarFontSize').innerText = currentFontSize;
2578 |     applyFontSizePt(currentFontSize);
2579 | }
2580 | 
2581 | function applyPresetFontSize(preset) {
2582 |     let map = { small: 9, normal: 11, large: 16, huge: 22 };
2583 |     let size = map[preset] || 11;
2584 |     setNumericFontSize(size);
2585 | }
2586 | 
2587 | function applyFontSizePt(ptSize) {
2588 |     const sel = window.getSelection();
2589 |     if (sel && sel.rangeCount > 0 && !sel.isCollapsed) {
2590 |         document.execCommand("fontSize", false, "7");
2591 |         const fontElements = document.getElementsByTagName("font");
2592 |         for (let i = 0; i < fontElements.length; i++) {
2593 |             if (fontElements[i].size == "7") {
2594 |                 fontElements[i].removeAttribute("size");
2595 |                 fontElements[i].style.fontSize = ptSize + "pt";
2596 |             }
2597 |         }
2598 |     } else {
2599 |         const active = document.activeElement;
2600 |         if (active && active.classList.contains('calib-field-text')) {
2601 |             active.style.fontSize = ptSize + "pt";
2602 |         }
2603 |     }
2604 | }
2605 | 
2606 | function changeFontSize(delta) {
2607 |     currentFontSize += delta;
2608 |     if (currentFontSize < 8) currentFontSize = 8;
2609 |     if (currentFontSize > 72) currentFontSize = 72;
2610 |     document.getElementById('toolbarFontSize').innerText = currentFontSize;
2611 |     
2612 |     const selection = window.getSelection();
2613 |     if (selection.rangeCount > 0 && !selection.isCollapsed) {
2614 |         document.execCommand("fontSize", false, "7");
2615 |         const fontElements = document.getElementsByTagName("font");
2616 |         for (let i = 0; i < fontElements.length; i++) {
2617 |             if (fontElements[i].size == "7") {
2618 |                 fontElements[i].removeAttribute("size");
2619 |                 fontElements[i].style.fontSize = currentFontSize + "pt";
2620 |             }
2621 |         }
2622 |     } else {
2623 |         const active = document.activeElement;
2624 |         if (active && active.classList.contains('calib-field-text')) {
2625 |             active.style.fontSize = currentFontSize + "pt";
2626 |         }
2627 |     }
2628 | }
2629 | 
2630 | // Undo logic
2631 | function pushCalibState() {
2632 |     let state = [];
2633 |     const paperW = document.getElementById('calibPaper').offsetWidth;
2634 |     const paperH = document.getElementById('calibPaper').offsetHeight;
2635 | 
2636 |     document.querySelectorAll('.calib-field').forEach(el => {
2637 |         let name = el.dataset.name;
2638 |         // Keep precise size state 
2639 |         if (paperW && paperH) {
2640 |              calibPositions[name].w = ((el.offsetWidth / paperW) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
2641 |              calibPositions[name].h = ((el.offsetHeight / paperH) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
2642 |         }
2643 | 
2644 |         const textEl = el.querySelector('.calib-field-text');
2645 |         state.push({
2646 |             name: name,
2647 |             x: calibPositions[name].x,
2648 |             y: calibPositions[name].y,
2649 |             w: calibPositions[name].w,
2650 |             h: calibPositions[name].h,
2651 |             left: el.style.left,
2652 |             top: el.style.top,
2653 |             width: el.style.width,
2654 |             height: el.style.height,
2655 |             html: textEl ? textEl.innerHTML : '',
2656 |             value: document.getElementById('field-' + name)?.value || ''
2657 |         });
2658 |     });
2659 |     
2660 |     let stateString = JSON.stringify(state);
2661 |     if (calibHistory.length === 0 || JSON.stringify(calibHistory[calibHistory.length - 1]) !== stateString) {
2662 |         calibHistory.push(state);
2663 |     }
2664 | }
2665 | 
2666 | function undoCalibration() {
2667 |     if (calibHistory.length <= 1) return;
2668 |     calibHistory.pop(); // discard current state
2669 |     const prevState = calibHistory[calibHistory.length - 1]; // get previous
2670 |     
2671 |     prevState.forEach(s => {
2672 |         calibPositions[s.name].x = s.x;
2673 |         calibPositions[s.name].y = s.y;
2674 |         calibPositions[s.name].w = s.w;
2675 |         calibPositions[s.name].h = s.h;
2676 |         
2677 |         let el = document.querySelector('.calib-field[data-name="' + s.name + '"]');
2678 |         if (el) {
2679 |             el.style.left = s.x + '%';
2680 |             el.style.top = s.y + '%';
2681 |             el.style.width = s.w;
2682 |             if (s.h && s.h !== 'auto') {
2683 |                 el.style.height = s.h;
2684 |             } else {
2685 |                 el.style.height = 'auto';
2686 |             }
2687 |             
2688 |             const textEl = el.querySelector('.calib-field-text');
2689 |             if (textEl) {
2690 |                 textEl.innerHTML = s.html;
2691 |             }
2692 |         }
2693 |         
2694 |         // Sync to underlying form
2695 |         let input = document.getElementById('field-' + s.name);
2696 |         if (input) {
2697 |             input.value = s.value;
2698 |             input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
2699 |         }
2700 |         
2701 |         // Live preview sync
2702 |         const previewEl = document.getElementById('preview-' + s.name);
2703 |         if (previewEl) {
2704 |             previewEl.style.left = s.x + '%';
2705 |             previewEl.style.top  = s.y + '%';
2706 |         }
2707 |     });
2708 | }
2709 | 
2710 | // Build initial positions from PHP layout
2711 | const baseLayouts = @json($fields);
2712 | baseLayouts.forEach(f => {
2713 |     // Convert percent string like "10%" to number 10
2714 |     const px = parseFloat((f.x || '10%').replace('%',''));
2715 |     const py = parseFloat((f.y || '10%').replace('%',''));
2716 |     calibPositions[f.name] = { x: px, y: py, w: f.w || '40%', h: f.h || 'auto', locked: !!f.locked };
2717 | });
2718 | 
2719 | function openCalibration() {
2720 |     const overlay = document.getElementById('calibrationOverlay');
2721 |     const paper   = document.getElementById('calibPaper');
2722 | 
2723 |     // Clear old boxes
2724 |     paper.querySelectorAll('.calib-field').forEach(el => el.remove());
2725 |     calibHistory = []; // Reset undo stack
2726 | 
2727 |     // First show the overlay so the paper has a real rendered size
2728 |     overlay.classList.add('active');
2729 |     document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
2730 | 
2731 |     // Use requestAnimationFrame so the DOM has laid out before we measure
2732 |     requestAnimationFrame(function() {
2733 |         const paperW = paper.offsetWidth;
2734 |         const paperH = paper.offsetHeight;
2735 | 
2736 |         // Build a draggable box for each field
2737 |         baseLayouts.forEach(function(f) {
2738 |             const name  = f.name;
2739 |             const el    = document.getElementById('field-' + name);
2740 |             const value = el ? (el.value || el.textContent || '') : (f.default || f.label || name);
2741 |             const displayText = (value && value.trim()) ? value.trim() : ('[ ' + (f.label || name) + ' ]');
2742 | 
2743 |             const pos = calibPositions[name];
2744 |             // Convert saved % positions → pixels in the actual rendered paper
2745 |             const xPx = (pos.x / 100) * paperW;
2746 |             const yPx = (pos.y / 100) * paperH;
2747 |             const wPx = pos.w && pos.w !== 'auto' ? (parseFloat(pos.w) / 100) * paperW : 140;
2748 | 
2749 |             const box = document.createElement('div');
2750 |             box.className    = 'calib-field';
2751 |             box.dataset.name = name;
2752 |             box.dataset.locked = f.locked ? 'true' : 'false';
2753 |             box.style.left   = xPx + 'px';
2754 |             box.style.top    = yPx + 'px';
2755 |             box.style.width  = wPx + 'px';
2756 |             
2757 |             
2758 |             // Inner text container to protect resizers/drag-handles from getting overridden!
2759 |             const textEl = document.createElement('div');
2760 |             textEl.className = 'calib-field-text';
2761 |             textEl.contentEditable = 'true';
2762 |             textEl.style.width = '100%';
2763 |             textEl.style.height = '100%';
2764 |             textEl.style.outline = 'none';
2765 |             textEl.innerHTML = displayText;
2766 | 
2767 |             // Live sync back to inputs
2768 |             textEl.addEventListener('input', function() {
2769 |                 const targetInput = document.getElementById('field-' + name);
2770 |                 if (targetInput) {
2771 |                     targetInput.value = this.textContent;
2772 |                     // Trigger input event to update forms preview as well
2773 |                     targetInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
2774 |                 }
2775 |             });
2776 |             
2777 |             textEl.addEventListener('blur', pushCalibState);
2778 |             
2779 |             box.appendChild(textEl);
2780 | 
2781 |             // Label tag above box showing field name
2782 |             const tag = document.createElement('span');
2783 |             tag.className   = 'calib-label-tag';
2784 |             tag.textContent = f.label || name;
2785 |             tag.contentEditable = 'false';
2786 |             box.appendChild(tag);
2787 |             
2788 |             // Drag handle to move the box
2789 |             const handle = document.createElement('div');
2790 |             handle.className = 'calib-drag-handle';
2791 |             handle.innerHTML = '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><path d="M5 9l-3 3 3 3M9 5l3-3 3 3M19 9l3 3-3 3M9 19l3 3 3-3M2 12h20M12 2v20"/></svg>';

2819 | function makeDraggable(el, handle) {
2820 |     if (el.dataset.locked === 'true') return;
2821 |     const paper   = document.getElementById('calibPaper');
2822 |     const readout = document.getElementById('calibReadout');
2823 | 
2824 |     handle.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
2825 |         // Only respond to left-button clicks
2826 |         if (e.button !== 0) return;
2827 |         e.preventDefault();
2828 |         e.stopPropagation();
2829 | 
2830 |         el.classList.add('dragging');
2831 |         readout.style.display = 'block';
2832 | 
2833 |         // Capture how far inside the element the user clicked.
2834 |         // This prevents the box from "jumping" to have its corner at the cursor.
2835 |         const elRect    = el.getBoundingClientRect();
2836 |         const clickOffX = e.clientX - elRect.left;
2837 |         const clickOffY = e.clientY - elRect.top;
2838 | 
2839 |         function onMove(e) {
2840 |             // Get the paper's current screen position on every move.
2841 |             // This stays accurate even when the calibration body is scrolled.
2842 |             const paperRect = paper.getBoundingClientRect();
2843 |             const paperW    = paper.offsetWidth;   // actual rendered width
2844 |             const paperH    = paper.offsetHeight;  // actual rendered height
2845 | 
2846 |             // Desired top-left of the element in paper-local pixels
2847 |             let newL = e.clientX - paperRect.left - clickOffX;
2848 |             let newT = e.clientY - paperRect.top  - clickOffY;
2849 | 
2850 |             // Clamp so the element stays fully inside the paper
2851 |             newL = Math.max(0, Math.min(paperW  - el.offsetWidth,  newL));
2852 |             newT = Math.max(0, Math.min(paperH  - el.offsetHeight, newT));
2853 | 
2854 |             // Convert px → % using the ACTUAL rendered paper size
2855 |             const xPct = ((newL / paperW) * 100).toFixed(2);
2856 |             const yPct = ((newT / paperH) * 100).toFixed(2);
2857 | 
2858 |             el.style.left = xPct + '%';
2859 |             el.style.top  = yPct + '%';
2860 | 
2861 |             // Update readout
2862 |             readout.textContent = '📍 ' + el.dataset.name
2863 |                 + '   x: ' + xPct + '%'
2864 |                 + '   y: ' + yPct + '%';
2865 | 
2866 |             // Keep calibPositions in sync
2867 |             calibPositions[el.dataset.name].x = parseFloat(xPct);
2868 |             calibPositions[el.dataset.name].y = parseFloat(yPct);
2869 | 
2870 |             // Mirror to the live preview panel in real-time
2871 |             const previewEl = document.getElementById('preview-' + el.dataset.name);
2872 |             if (previewEl) {
2873 |                 previewEl.style.left = xPct + '%';
2874 |                 previewEl.style.top  = yPct + '%';
2875 |             }
2876 |         }
2877 | 
2878 |         function onUp() {
2879 |             el.classList.remove('dragging');
2880 |             document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
2881 |             document.removeEventListener('mouseup',   onUp);
2882 |             setTimeout(function() { readout.style.display = 'none'; }, 2000);
2883 |             pushCalibState(); // Save state after drag
2884 |         }
2885 | 
2886 |         document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
2887 |         document.addEventListener('mouseup',   onUp);
2888 |     });
2889 | }
2890 | 
2891 | function makeResizable(el, resizer) {
2892 |     if (el.dataset.locked === 'true') return;
2893 |     const paper = document.getElementById('calibPaper');
2894 | 
2895 |     resizer.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
2896 |         if (e.button !== 0) return;
2897 |         e.preventDefault();
2898 |         e.stopPropagation();
2899 | 
2900 |         const startX = e.clientX;
2901 |         const startY = e.clientY;
2902 |         const startWidth = parseInt(document.defaultView.getComputedStyle(el).width, 10);
2903 |         const startHeight = parseInt(document.defaultView.getComputedStyle(el).height, 10);
2904 | 
2905 |         function onResizeMove(e) {
2906 |             const paperRect = paper.getBoundingClientRect();
2907 |             // Constraint inside paper bounds
2908 |             let newWidth = startWidth + (e.clientX - startX);
2909 |             let newHeight = startHeight + (e.clientY - startY);
2910 |             
2911 |             // Min sizes
2912 |             if (newWidth < 40) newWidth = 40;
2913 |             if (newHeight < 20) newHeight = 20;
2914 | 
2915 |             // Maximum allowed
2916 |             const maxW = paperRect.width - el.offsetLeft;
2917 |             const maxH = paperRect.height - el.offsetTop;
2918 |             
2919 |             if (newWidth > maxW) newWidth = maxW;
2920 |             if (newHeight > maxH) newHeight = maxH;
2921 | 
2922 |             // Convert to % for responsiveness
2923 |             const wPct = ((newWidth / paperRect.width) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
2924 |             const hPct = ((newHeight / paperRect.height) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
2925 | 
2926 |             el.style.width = wPct;
2927 |             el.style.height = hPct;
2928 | 
2929 |             if (calibPositions[name]) {
2930 |                 calibPositions[name].w = wPct;
2931 |                 calibPositions[name].h = hPct;
2932 |             }
2933 |         }
2934 | 
2935 |         function onResizeUp() {
2936 |             document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onResizeMove);
2937 |             document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onResizeUp);
2938 |             if (calibPositions[name]) {
2939 |                 calibPositions[name].w = el.style.width;
2940 |                 calibPositions[name].h = el.style.height;
2941 |             }
2942 |             pushCalibState();
2943 |         }
2944 | 
2945 |         document.addEventListener('mousemove', onResizeMove);
2946 |         document.addEventListener('mouseup', onResizeUp);
2947 |     });
2948 | }

2951 | function saveCalibration() {
2952 |     const btn = document.getElementById('calibSaveBtn');
2953 |     btn.textContent = 'Saving...';
2954 |     btn.disabled    = true;
2955 | 
2956 |     // Build positions payload: name → { x: "12.5%", y: "22.1%", w, h }
2957 |     const positions = {};
2958 |     Object.entries(calibPositions).forEach(([name, pos]) => {
2959 |         const xVal = typeof pos.x === 'number' ? pos.x.toFixed(2) + '%' : pos.x;
2960 |         const yVal = typeof pos.y === 'number' ? pos.y.toFixed(2) + '%' : pos.y;
2961 |         const wVal = pos.w || '40%';
2962 |         const hVal = pos.h || 'auto';

2964 |             x: xVal,

2966 |             w: wVal,
2967 |             h: hVal,
2968 |         };
2969 |     });
2970 |

2972 | 
2973 |     // Build content payload to save document data to database
2974 |     const contentToSave = {};
2975 |     document.querySelectorAll('[id^="field-"]').forEach(el => {
2976 |         const n = el.id.replace('field-', '');
2977 |         contentToSave[n] = el.value || el.textContent || '';
2978 |     });
2979 |

2981 |         method: 'POST',

2990 |             positions: positions,
2991 |             content: contentToSave,
2992 |         }),

2995 |     .then(data => {

2997 |         btn.disabled    = false;
2998 | 
2999 |         if (data.success) {
3000 |             showCalibToast();
3001 |             // Update the live preview overlay positions, width, and font styling to match
3002 |             Object.entries(positions).forEach(([name, pos]) => {

3005 |                     previewEl.style.left = pos.x;
3006 |                     previewEl.style.top  = pos.y;
3007 |                     if (pos.w) previewEl.style.width = pos.w;
3008 |                     if (pos.font_family) previewEl.style.fontFamily = "'" + pos.font_family + "', Arial, sans-serif";
3009 |                     if (pos.font_size) previewEl.style.fontSize = pos.font_size;
3010 |                 }
3011 |             });

 694 |             let val = parseInt(numInput.value) || 11;
 695 |             val += 1;
 696 |             numInput.value = val;

 700 |         function decreaseFontSize() {
 701 |             const numInput = document.getElementById('font-size-num');
 702 |             let val = parseInt(numInput.value) || 11;
 703 |             if (val > 6) val -= 1;
 704 |             numInput.value = val;
 705 |             setNumericFontSize(val);
 706 |         }

 708 |         function setNumericFontSize(val) {
 709 |             const pt = parseInt(val) || 11;
 710 |             document.execCommand('fontSize', false, '3');
 711 |             const sel = window.getSelection();
 712 |             if (sel.rangeCount > 0) {
 713 |                 const range = sel.getRangeAt(0);
 714 |                 const fontEls = range.commonAncestorContainer.parentElement ? range.commonAncestorContainer.parentElement.querySelectorAll('font[size="3"]') : [];
 715 |                 fontEls.forEach(el => {
 716 |                     el.removeAttribute('size');
 717 |                     el.style.fontSize = pt + 'pt';
 718 |                 });
 719 |             }
 720 |         }

 723 |             let pt = 11;

 725 |             if (preset === 'normal') pt = 11;
 726 |             if (preset === 'large') pt = 14;
 727 |             if (preset === 'huge') pt = 18;
 728 |             const numInput = document.getElementById('font-size-num');
 729 |             if (numInput) numInput.value = pt;
 730 |             setNumericFontSize(pt);
 731 |         }

 841 |         // --- Form Submission ---
 842 |         function submitForm() {
 843 |             const container = document.getElementById('hidden-inputs-container');
 844 |             container.innerHTML = ''; // Clear previous
 845 | 
 846 |             if (caseId && caseId !== 'null') {
 847 |                 const caseInput = document.createElement('input');
 848 |                 caseInput.type = 'hidden';
 849 |                 caseInput.name = 'case_id';
 850 |                 caseInput.value = caseId;
 851 |                 container.appendChild(caseInput);
 852 |             }
 853 | 
 854 |             const fields = document.querySelectorAll('.doc-field');
 855 |             const parent = document.getElementById('page-canvas');
 856 |             const parentW = parent.offsetWidth;
 857 |             const parentH = parent.offsetHeight;
 858 | 
 859 |             let overrides = {};
 860 | 
 861 |             fields.forEach(field => {
 862 |                 const name = field.getAttribute('data-name');
 863 |                 const value = field.innerText.trim(); // Trim whitespace
 864 | 
 865 |                 // Create hidden input for value
 866 |                 const input = document.createElement('input');
 867 |                 input.type = 'hidden';
 868 |                 input.name = name;
 869 |                 input.value = value;
 870 |                 container.appendChild(input);
 871 | 
 872 |                 // Use explicit stored attributes unless in layout mode
 873 |                 let x = field.getAttribute('data-x');
 874 |                 let y = field.getAttribute('data-y');
 875 |                 let w = field.getAttribute('data-w');
 876 |                 let h = field.getAttribute('data-h') || 'auto';
 877 | 
 878 |                 if (!x || isLayoutMode) {
 879 |                     x = (field.offsetLeft / parentW * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
 880 |                 }
 881 |                 if (!y || isLayoutMode) {
 882 |                     y = (field.offsetTop / parentH * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
 883 |                 }
 884 |                 if (!w || isLayoutMode) {
 885 |                     w = (field.offsetWidth / parentW * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
 886 |                 }
 887 |                 if (isLayoutMode && field.style.height && field.style.height !== 'auto') {
 888 |                     h = (field.offsetHeight / parentH * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
 889 |                 }
 890 | 
 891 |                 overrides[name] = { x, y, w, h };
 892 |             });
 893 | 
 894 |             // Store overrides in hidden input
 895 |             document.getElementById('layout-overrides').value = JSON.stringify(overrides);
 896 | 
 897 |             document.getElementById('doc-form').submit();
 898 |         }

1030 |         function selectField(el, append = false) {
1031 |             if (!append) {
1032 |                 selectedEls.forEach(item => {
1033 |                     item.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-blue-500', 'bg-blue-50');
1034 |                 });
1035 |                 selectedEls = [el];
1036 |             } else {
1037 |                 const index = selectedEls.indexOf(el);
1038 |                 if (index > -1) {
1039 |                     el.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-blue-500', 'bg-blue-50');
1040 |                     selectedEls.splice(index, 1);
1041 |                     updateLockBtnState();
1042 |                     return;
1043 |                 } else {
1044 |                     selectedEls.push(el);
1045 |                 }
1046 |             }
1047 | 
1048 |             el.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-blue-500', 'bg-blue-50');
1049 |             updateLockBtnState();
1050 |         }

1058 |         }

1060 |         function toggleLockSelectedField() {
1061 |             if (selectedEls.length === 0) return;
1062 | 
1063 |             const anyLocked = selectedEls.some(el => el.getAttribute('data-locked') === 'true');
1064 |             const targetState = anyLocked ? 'false' : 'true';
1065 | 
1066 |             selectedEls.forEach(el => {
1067 |                 el.setAttribute('data-locked', targetState);
1068 |             });
1069 | 
1070 |             updateLockBtnState();
1071 |         }

1073 |         function updateLockBtnState() {

1142 |         function onResizeStart(e, mode) {
1143 |             if (!isLayoutMode) return;
1144 |             
1145 |             const clickedField = e.currentTarget.parentElement;
1146 |             if (clickedField.getAttribute('data-locked') === 'true') return;
1147 | 
1148 |             e.preventDefault();
1149 |             e.stopPropagation(); // Prevent drag
1150 | 
1151 |             resizingEl = clickedField;
1152 |             resizeMode = mode;
1153 |             resizeRefX = e.clientX;
1154 |             resizeRefY = e.clientY;
1155 | 
1156 |             // Make sure the clicked field is part of the selection.
1157 |             if (!selectedEls.includes(resizingEl)) {
1158 |                 selectField(resizingEl, false);
1159 |             }
1160 | 
1161 |             resizingFields = [];
1162 |             selectedEls.forEach(el => {
1163 |                 if (el.getAttribute('data-locked') !== 'true') {
1164 |                     resizingFields.push({
1165 |                         el: el,
1166 |                         startW: el.offsetWidth,
1167 |                         startH: el.offsetHeight,
1168 |                         startLeft: el.offsetLeft,
1169 |                         startTop: el.offsetTop
1170 |                     });
1171 |                 }
1172 |             });
1173 |

1175 |             document.addEventListener('mouseup', onResizeEnd);
1176 |         }
1177 | 
1178 |         function onResizeMove(e) {
1179 |             if (!resizingEl || resizingFields.length === 0) return;
1180 |             e.preventDefault();
1181 | 
1182 |             const dx = e.clientX - resizeRefX;
1183 |             const dy = e.clientY - resizeRefY;
1184 | 
1185 |             resizingFields.forEach(item => {
1186 |                 if (resizeMode === 'w') {
1187 |                     item.el.style.width = (item.startW + dx) + 'px';
1188 |                 } else if (resizeMode === 'h') {
1189 |                     item.el.style.height = (item.startH + dy) + 'px';
1190 |                 } else if (resizeMode === 'l') {
1191 |                     item.el.style.width = (item.startW - dx) + 'px';
1192 |                     item.el.style.left = (item.startLeft + dx) + 'px';
1193 |                 } else if (resizeMode === 't') {
1194 |                     item.el.style.height = (item.startH - dy) + 'px';
1195 |                     item.el.style.top = (item.startTop + dy) + 'px';
1196 |                 }
1197 |             });
1198 |         }

1200 |         function updateFieldDataPos(el) {
1201 |             const parent = document.getElementById('page-canvas');
1202 |             if (!parent) return;
1203 |             const parentW = parent.offsetWidth;
1204 |             const parentH = parent.offsetHeight;

1206 |                 const x = ((el.offsetLeft / parentW) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
1207 |                 const y = ((el.offsetTop / parentH) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
1208 |                 const w = ((el.offsetWidth / parentW) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
1209 |                 let h = 'auto';

1211 |                     h = ((el.offsetHeight / parentH) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';

1238 |             if (!isLayoutMode) return;

1256 |                     selectField(clickedEl, false);

1277 |                         startTop: el.offsetTop
1278 |                     });

1458 |         function saveLayout() {
1459 |             const fields = document.querySelectorAll('.doc-field');
1460 |             const layout = [];
1461 |             const container = document.getElementById('page-canvas');
1462 | 
1463 |             // Use getBoundingClientRect for more accurate relative positioning
1464 |             const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
1465 |             const parentW = containerRect.width;
1466 |             const parentH = containerRect.height;
1467 | 
1468 |             if (parentW === 0 || parentH === 0) {
1469 |                 alert('Error: Canvas dimensions are zero. Cannot save layout.');
1470 |                 return;
1471 |             }
1472 | 
1473 |             fields.forEach(field => {
1474 |                 const fieldRect = field.getBoundingClientRect();
1475 |                 const name = field.getAttribute('data-name');
1476 | 
1477 |                 // Calculate relative position based on viewport rects
1478 |                 const relativeLeft = fieldRect.left - containerRect.left;
1479 |                 const relativeTop = fieldRect.top - containerRect.top;
1480 | 
1481 |                 const x = (relativeLeft / parentW * 100).toFixed(4) + '%';
1482 |                 const y = (relativeTop / parentH * 100).toFixed(4) + '%';
1483 |                 const w = (fieldRect.width / parentW * 100).toFixed(4) + '%';
1484 | 
1485 |                 let h = field.style.height;
1486 |                 if (!h || h === 'auto') {
1487 |                     if (field.style.height && field.style.height !== 'auto') {
1488 |                         h = field.style.height;
1489 |                     } else {
1490 |                         h = 'auto';
1491 |                     }
1492 |                 } else if (h.includes('px')) {
1493 |                     h = (parseFloat(h) / parentH * 100).toFixed(4) + '%';
1494 |                 }
1495 | 
1496 |                 layout.push({
1497 |                     name: name,
1498 |                     x: x,
1499 |                     y: y,
1500 |                     w: w,
1501 |                     h: h,
1502 |                     class: field.className.replace('doc-field', '').replace('cursor-pointer', '').replace('ring-2', '').replace('ring-blue-500', '').replace('bg-blue-50', '').trim(),
1503 |                     type: field.getAttribute('data-type') || 'text',
1504 |                     default: field.innerHTML,
1505 |                     locked: field.getAttribute('data-locked') === 'true'
1506 |                 });
1507 |             });
1508 | 
1509 |             const btn = document.getElementById('btn-save-layout');
1510 |             const originalContent = btn.innerHTML;
1511 | 
1512 |             btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-icons-outlined animate-spin">refresh</span> Saving...';
1513 |             btn.disabled = true;
1514 |             btn.classList.add('opacity-75');
1515 | 
1516 |             const token = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').getAttribute('content');
1517 | 
1518 |             fetch('/documents/save-layout', {
1519 |                 method: 'POST',
1520 |                 headers: {
1521 |                     'Content-Type': 'application/json',
1522 |                     'Accept': 'application/json',
1523 |                     'X-CSRF-TOKEN': token
1524 |                 },
1525 |                 body: JSON.stringify({
1526 |                     document_type: '{{ $type }}',
1527 |                     layout: layout
1528 |                 })
1529 |             })
1530 |                 .then(response => response.json())
1531 |                 .then(data => {
1532 |                     if (data.success) {
1533 |                         btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-icons-outlined">check_circle</span> Saved!';
1534 |                         setTimeout(() => {
1535 |                             btn.innerHTML = originalContent;
